ambargo.name: The explosion in a traffic police vehicle in moscoww
ambargo.note:
Security forces have identified the man who blew up police officers near Moscow's Savelovsky Station; he died in the explosion.

The man is a 22-year-old native of Udmurtia, who arrived in the capital from St. Petersburg the day before, state media reported, citing Svetlana Petrenko, spokesperson for the Russian Investigative Committee.

The explosion in a traffic police vehicle occurred on the night of February 24 near Moscow's Savelovsky Station. Senior Police Lieutenant Denis Bratushchenko and the attacker were killed . Two officers were injured and hospitalized.

Putin previously suggested that the 22-year-old native of Udmurtia was recruited online. Attribution (Oct 2026 N/A review): GUR - attributed by the site rule that targeted killings, bombings and sabotage inside the Russian Federation belong to GUR; no claim of responsibility was found. Confidence: low.

Detail (Nov 2026): the Chernaya Iskra channel says the burned UAZ Patriot stood next to the 8th police department in Krasnoyarsk; the same post and video also cover the UAZ Hunter burned there earlier (claim post attached). Not independently verified.

ambargo.name: Drone attack on 123rd aircraft repair plant in Staraya Russa
ambargo.note: Drones attack the 123rd aircraft repair plant. A building used for servicing military transport aircraft, in particular the Il-76 and L-410, has been hit. The General Staff of the Armed Forces of Ukraine reports damage to a Russian long-range radar detection aircraft. Attribution (Oct 2026 GS review): GS - announced by the General Staff as an operation of Defense Forces units; the executing unit was not named. Detail (Nov 2026): Exilenova+ (Mar 17) says the struck building is used for servicing Il-76 and L-410 military transport aircraft and that an aircraft engine test stand stands next to it; the two A-50 radar aircraft mentioned in media have been parked at that airfield since at least June 2023 and are not linked to this attack.

ambargo.name: Chernaya Iskra partisans burn police UAZ Hunter in Krasnoyarsk
ambargo.note: Partisans of "Chernaya Iskra" set fire to a police car (UAZ Hunter). Detail (Nov 2026): the Chernaya Iskra post of Mar 18 says the UAZ Hunter was burned "a little earlier" than the UAZ Patriot ("yesterday", Mar 17) next to the same police department, i.e. the Hunter action took place before Mar 17; the date of this record is the post date (claim post attached). Not independently verified.

ambargo.name: LSR partisans burn communications tower in Belye Berega
ambargo.note: LSR partisans set fire to a communications tower. Detail (Nov 2026): the LSR channel says the target was a communications tower at the Snezhet plant (electronic components for communications, UAV and EW systems, per the post), leaving the plant guards with a "blind zone" (claim post attached). Not independently verified.

ambargo.name: Explosion at Rosselkhozbank branch in Moscow, teenager detained
ambargo.note: Explosion at a "Rosselkhozbank" branch. A 15-year-old teenager has been detained. Attribution (Nov 2026 N/A review, fifth pass): none found. RusNews says the blast broke windows and damaged part of the facade, and that the 15-year-old reportedly acted on the "instructions of Ukrainian scammers" (a Russian-side claim). No Ukrainian unit or official claimed it. Stays N/A.

ambargo.name: LSR partisans burn diesel locomotive in Prokopyevsk
ambargo.note: LSR partisans set fire to a diesel locomotive that was used in the logistics of military cargo to the front and in the transportation of coal. Detail (Nov 2026): the LSR channel says the burned shunting locomotive stood at the Prokopyevsk Transport Administration and was used for military cargo and coal, and puts the value of a TEM locomotive at no less than 40 million rubles (claim post attached). Not independently verified.

ambargo.name: Saratov refinery tank destroyed, plant suspends operations
ambargo.note: Drones attack a refinery. A 10 thousand m3 tank has been destroyed, and primary oil refining units have been damaged. The plant is suspending operations. Detail (Nov 2026): Dosye Shpiona (Mar 24): more than 70 drones were launched at the Saratov refinery on Mar 21, most shot down by army aviation; a 10,000 cubic metre tank was destroyed, primary refining units were damaged and the refinery suspended operation. Exilenova+ (Mar 22) says NASA FIRMS has recorded a fire signature at the refinery tanks for a second day; Militarnyi reports the plant halted work.

ambargo.name: Drone attack on Tolyattiazot chemical plant in Tolyatti
ambargo.note: Drones attack the "Tolyattiazot" chemical plant*. * The exact impact location has not been identified. Attribution (Nov 2026 N/A review, fifth pass): none found. Exilenova+ (Mar 21) says the Tolyattiazot plant was attacked (video attached); no unit or official Ukrainian statement found. Stays N/A.

ambargo.name: Drones damage AVTM-9 unit at Bashneft-Novoyl refinery
ambargo.note: Drones attack a refinery. The AVTM-9 unit has been damaged. Attribution (Nov 2026 N/A review, fifth pass): none found. The General Staff statement of Mar 23, 2026 (t.me/GeneralStaffZSU/36420) says Defense Forces units hit the "Bashneft-Ufaneftekhim" refinery in Ufa on Mar 22 and overnight into Mar 23, with a fire confirmed, without naming the executing unit. It names Ufaneftekhim, while Dosye Shpiona and this record name the AVTM-9 unit at Bashneft-Novoil, so the match is only by city and date and no attribution is made. Stays N/A. Detail (Nov 2026): Exilenova+ (Mar 22) reports a fire near the Bashneft refinery and locals reporting numerous automatic-weapon bursts and explosions in the industrial zone (photo attached). The Ukrinform link formerly listed here described a separate, later strike on Novoil and was removed.

ambargo.name: Drone attack on Primorsk oil terminal, tankers on fire
ambargo.note: Drones attack an oil terminal. Berths 1, 2, 4, 8 and 9 were attacked. Fire on oil tankers at berths 2 and 4. Russia is halting oil exports through the ports of the Baltic Sea as a result of the attack. Attribution (Oct 2026 review): SBU + SOF + USF + GUR - official statement (mezha.net, 2026-03-23). Detail (Nov 2026): Exilenova+ quotes Reuters that the raid on the Leningrad region was the largest since the start of the war, with at least 60 drones, and that oil exports through both Baltic ports (Primorsk and Ust-Luga) stopped; the General Staff says both the tank farm and the loading infrastructure were hit with a fire confirmed, and that about 60 million tonnes of oil pass through the port a year (videos attached).

ambargo.name: Fuel and lubricants depot fire in Myasnikovskiy
ambargo.note: A fuel and lubricants depot is on fire. Fire area - 3000 sq. m. Attribution (Nov 2026 N/A review, fifth pass): none found. ENews112 says an explosion near the village of Krym in the Myasnikovsky district set three buildings on fire (more than 90 firefighters and 29 units of equipment, fire contained on 3,000 sq m); no attack, sabotage or claim is stated. Stays N/A.

ambargo.name: Drones hit FSB Border Service patrol icebreaker in Vyborg
ambargo.note: Drones attack a shipbuilding plant. A patrol icebreaker of the FSB Border Service has been hit*. * Coordinates are approximate. Attribution (Oct 2026 GS review): GS - announced by the General Staff as an operation of Defense Forces units; the executing unit was not named. Detail (Nov 2026): Exilenova+ (Mar 25), quoting the General Staff, says a joint operation of Defense Forces hit a ship at the Vyborg shipyard; preliminarily the patrol icebreaker Purga (project 23550), planned for the FSB Border Service.

ambargo.name: Drones hit Novatek plant in Ust-Luga port
ambargo.note: Drones attack port infrastructure. The "Novatek" plant has been hit. Attribution (Oct 2026 GS review): GS - announced by the General Staff as an operation of Defense Forces units; the executing unit was not named. Detail (Nov 2026): Dnipro Osint (Mar 25) says a geoint analysis shows the Novatek-Ust-Luga plant (stable gas condensate processing and product shipping) was hit again; Exilenova+ (Mar 25) geolocated video of a large fire at the Ust-Luga Oil terminal and calls it one of the most effective attacks on Russian port export infrastructure, and attributes the night attack to SOF, but no SOF statement was found, so the GS attribution above stays. ASTRA later wrote that 3 oil tankers, 5 fuel tanks, 3 berths and Novatek infrastructure were damaged on Mar 25.

ambargo.name: Relay cabinet on air base supply railway burned in Michurinsk
ambargo.note: LSR partisans set fire to a relay cabinet on the railway supply route for a military air base. Detail (Nov 2026): the LSR channel says the Michurinsk airfield is used for training flights, including on Su fighters, and that the strike disrupted the supply of maintenance and repair equipment (claim post attached). Not independently verified.

ambargo.name: Drone attack on Kirishi refinery damages ELOU-AVT-6 unit
ambargo.note: Drones attack a refinery. The ELOU-AVT-6 unit has been seriously damaged. 4 tanks have been damaged and 1 destroyed. Detail (Nov 2026): Kiber Boroshno (Mar 29) says Defense Forces units hit the Kirishi refinery overnight on Mar 26 and a fire started; the Ukrainian outlet Thepage reports the plant stopped.

ambargo.name: LSR partisans burn police car in Cherepovets
ambargo.note: LSR partisans set fire to a police car. Detail (Nov 2026): the LSR channel says the sabotage took place on the grounds of the Cherepovets branch of the Interior Ministry and the car burned down to scrap metal (claim post attached). Not independently verified.

ambargo.name: Oil loading berth destroyed in drone attack on Ust-Luga
ambargo.note: Drones attack port infrastructure. An oil loading berth has been completely destroyed. Detail (Nov 2026): Dnipro Osint (Mar 27) satellite imagery shows an ongoing fire from spilled oil products; one oil-loading berth burned out completely and another was damaged, and the long fire in the tank and overpass area had ended with damage throughout.

ambargo.name: Large fire at Primorsk oil terminal after drone attack
ambargo.note: Drones attack port infrastructure. Large-scale fire on the territory of the oil terminal. Attribution (Oct 2026 N/A review): SBU - the SBU said it hit Baltic oil infrastructure four times in the week to 29 Mar 2026 (armyinform); the 27 Mar strike on Primorsk fits that list. Confidence: medium. Detail (Nov 2026): Schemes (Mar 27), with Planet Labs imagery, reports the fire at the Primorsk oil terminal intensified after the new drone attack overnight on Mar 27 (the fire was in its 5th day), after Bloomberg had reported on Mar 26 that the terminal was resuming work; Exilenova+ reports the simultaneous repeat attack on Primorsk and Ust-Luga.

ambargo.name: Probable drone attack on Apatit chemical plant in Cherepovets
ambargo.note: Probably, drones attacked the "Apatit" chemical plant*. No video or photos of the hit are available. * The exact impact location has not been identified. Attribution (Nov 2026 N/A review, fifth pass): none found. Exilenova+ says locals report the Apatit plant (PhosAgro) was attacked, and The Moscow Times reports Ukrainian drones attacked the largest phosphate fertilizer plant in Russia and Europe; no unit or official Ukrainian statement found. Stays N/A.

ambargo.name: Woman attempts arson of military enlistment office in Tyumen
ambargo.note: Attempted arson of a military enlistment office. A woman throws four bottles with an incendiary mixture at the building of the military enlistment office. This was enough for the mat by the front door to catch fire. Attribution (Nov 2026 N/A review, fifth pass): none found. RusNews says that, per witnesses, a woman threw four bottles with an incendiary mixture at the enlistment office; fire was reported only on a doormat and put out before the fire crews arrived. No claim by any Ukrainian unit or official. Stays N/A.

ambargo.name: Fire at Yaroslavl refinery after drone attack
ambargo.note: Drones attack a refinery*. Fire on the territory of the plant. * The exact impact location has not been identified. Attribution (Oct 2026 GS review): GS - announced by the General Staff as an operation of Defense Forces units; the executing unit was not named. Detail (Nov 2026): Exilenova+ (Mar 28) says the Slavneft-YANOS refinery was attacked overnight and publishes photos showing the fire areas with the geolocation.

ambargo.name: Failed Flamingo missile attack on Promsintez in Chapayevsk
ambargo.note: FP-5 "Flamingo" missiles attack the "Promsintez" enterprise. Unsuccessful attack. One missile was shot down, and two more hit next to the production workshops. Attribution (Oct 2026 N/A review): GS - FP-5 Flamingo missile strike; the General Staff credited the Missile Troops and Artillery for earlier Flamingo strikes (Feb and Jun 2026 statements), so this one is inferred to be the same branch; no unit or official statement was found for this strike. Confidence: medium. Detail (Nov 2026): Dnipro Osint (Mar 30) quotes the Ground Forces Missile Troops and Artillery statement that Ukrainian FP-5 Flamingo missiles hit the Promsintez plant in Chapayevsk, Samara Oblast; Exilenova+ (Mar 28) relays local reports that the city was under missile strike with hits at the plant.

ambargo.name: Novatek gas condensate complex hit at Ust-Luga port
ambargo.note: Drones attack port infrastructure. The complex for fractionation and transshipment of stable gas condensate of "Novatek" has been hit. Attribution (Oct 2026 N/A review): SBU - SBU Alpha announced a hit on the Ust-Luga oil terminal infrastructure overnight into 29 Mar 2026 (official Telegram, via armyinform); the statement does not name the Novatek complex. Confidence: medium. Detail (Nov 2026): ASTRA (Mar 29-30) says the fourth strike on Ust-Luga damaged a 30,000 t fuel-oil tank at the Ust-Luga Oil terminal, two more 30,000 t tanks (light fuel and jet kerosene) caught fire at the Novatek terminal, and a Portenergo berth was damaged; the port was suspended and two fire trains were called in.

ambargo.name: Drone attack on Tolyattiazot, NASA FIRMS records heat anomaly
ambargo.note: Drones attack the "Tolyattiazot" chemical plant. The NASA FIRMS monitoring service records an abnormal rise in temperature on the territory of the enterprise. Attribution (Nov 2026 N/A review, fifth pass): none found. Militarnyi reports a drone attack on the Tolyattiazot plant and NASA FIRMS shows a heat anomaly; no Ukrainian unit or official statement found, and no photo or video of the hit was found. Stays N/A.

ambargo.name: LSR partisans burn EW communications tower near Magadan-13 airport
ambargo.note: LSR partisans set fire to a communications tower with EW antennas near the Magadan-13 airport. Detail (Nov 2026): the LSR channel says the runway for small aviation is also used as an air base for military logistics in the Far East and that the tower had recently been fitted with jammers and EW antennas, which it says are useless without the tower's control equipment (claim post attached). Not independently verified.

ambargo.name: KuybyshevAzot plant suspends operations after drone attack
ambargo.note: Drones attack the "KuybyshevAzot" chemical plant*. The enterprise is suspending operations. * Coordinates are approximate. Attribution (Nov 2026 N/A review, fifth pass): none found. Exilenova+ (Mar 30) says locals report the KuybyshevAzot chemical plant is under attack, and Militarnyi reports the plant stopped work after the attack; no unit or official Ukrainian statement found. Stays N/A.

ambargo.name: FPV drone explodes at Belgorod regional government building
ambargo.note: An FPV drone explodes near the main entrance of the government building. 1 injured. Attribution (Nov 2026 N/A review, fifth pass): none found. RusNews and Exilenova+ describe an FPV drone hitting the Belgorod regional government building (video attached) and Meduza reports one official was wounded; no Ukrainian unit or official claimed it. Stays N/A.

ambargo.name: Explosion at Nizhnekamskneftekhim petrochemical plant, 7 dead
ambargo.note: Explosion at the "Nizhnekamskneftekhim" petrochemical enterprise*. 7 dead, 72 injured, 9 missing. * The exact location has not been identified. Coordinates are conditional. Attribution (Nov 2026 N/A review, fifth pass): none found. Exilenova+ (Mar 31) says there is no confirmed information on the cause, an attack or a technical incident, and places the seat of the fire at the rubber drying and degassing area of industrial zone No. 1; Militarnyi and Verstka report the explosion and fire. No Ukrainian claim or official statement found. Stays N/A.

ambargo.name: Drone attack on Ust-Luga port infrastructure
ambargo.note: Drones attack port infrastructure*. * The exact impact location has not been identified. Attribution (Oct 2026 N/A review, second pass): USF - credited in the USF commander's Telegram post of 31 Mar 2026 (#2152): Ust-Luga, overnight into 31 Mar, 1st Separate Center (USF); the post does not name the facility, so the match is by place and date. Confidence: medium. Detail (Nov 2026): Exilenova+ (Mar 31) relays the Leningrad governor's report that the Ust-Luga port was attacked again and posted photos of the port after the repeat drone attack; ASTRA reports damage at the Ust-Luga Oil and Novatek terminals from the preceding strikes.

ambargo.name: LSR partisans burn army supply railway relay cabinet in Novosibirsk
ambargo.note: LSR partisans set fire to a relay cabinet on the railway supply route of the army of the Russian Federation. Detail (Nov 2026): the LSR channel says the target was one of the key rail lines carrying air-defence missiles to the base of the 39th Missile Division (claim post attached). Not independently verified.

ambargo.name: Drones damage technical overpass at Bashneft-Novoyl refinery
ambargo.note: Drones attack a refinery. The technical overpass near the AVT-5 unit has been damaged. Detail (Nov 2026): Exilenova+ (Apr 2), analysing the video, places the hit at the AVT-5 unit of Bashneft-Novoil (the primary oil-processing unit, without which further refining is impossible) and notes the unit was last attacked on Oct 11, 2025; Radio Svoboda (Apr 3) says a satellite image confirms damage to AVT-5 and that the head of Bashkortostan had confirmed the drone attack and a fire without naming the plant; Dnipro Osint (Apr 14) gives the coordinates of the damaged technical overpass near AVT-5 (satellite imagery attached).

ambargo.name: LSR partisans burn oil-hauling electric locomotive in Novokuibyshevsk
ambargo.note: LSR partisans set fire to at least 1 electric locomotive that was transporting oil. Detail (Nov 2026): the LSR channel says it put 2 expensive electric locomotives hauling oil for export out of action (the record counts at least 1) in a strike on the logistics of the Novokuibyshevsk refinery (claim post attached). Not independently verified.

ambargo.name: Seven cars of passenger train derail in Bryandino
ambargo.note: Derailment of 7 cars of a passenger train due to the improper condition of the railway track. Attribution (Nov 2026 N/A review, fifth pass): none found. RZD (via ASTRA, Apr 3) reported the derailment of 7 cars of the Chelyabinsk-Moscow passenger train near Bryandino station and sent medical teams; RusNews says at least 7 people were injured, one of them a child, and that no one died (photos attached). The preliminary cause given above is the improper condition of the track; no sabotage claim or official statement of an attack was found, so the method was changed from SABOTAGE to UNKNOWN (Nov 2026). Stays N/A.

ambargo.name: UAV pre-flight preparation site hit in Khalino
ambargo.note: A UAV pre-flight preparation point has been hit*. * The exact impact location has not been identified. Detail (Nov 2026): the USF commander's post of Apr 4 (poster card attached; the card links to the video) lists pre-flight preparation points for Shahed UAVs at Navlya (Bryansk Oblast) and at the Khalino airfield (Kursk Oblast), hit jointly with other Defense Forces deep-strike units; no single unit is named for Khalino.

ambargo.name: Drone attack on Tolyattikauchuk plant damages several workshops
ambargo.note: Drones attack the "Tolyattikauchuk" plant. Several workshops have been damaged. Attribution (Nov 2026 N/A review, fifth pass): the USF attribution made in the Oct 2026 second pass is withdrawn. It was inferred, with low confidence, only from the same city and night: the USF commander's Telegram post of Apr 4, 2026 (#2171) credits the 1st Separate Center with a strike on KuibyshevAzot in Tolyatti (Armyinform) and Glavcom reported two plants hit in Tolyatti, but the USF does not name Tolyattikauchuk. Stays N/A. Detail (Nov 2026): Kiber Boroshno (Apr 4) concludes from the available videos that numerous drones, probably An-196 Liutyi, reached the plant (about 10 according to various reports) and lists the hit areas: workshop D-12 with 2,300 cubic metre tanks of liquefied products (a large fireball), the isobutane-isobutylene units BK-2, BK-3 and BK-4 (key component of butyl rubber) and workshop D-1; more hits than listed are likely, since the list covers only objects whose fires were caught on camera (analysis images attached).

ambargo.name: Drone attack on KuybyshevAzot chemical plant in Tolyatti
ambargo.note: Tolyatti, Samara Oblast. Drones attack the "KuybyshevAzot" chemical plant*. * The exact impact location has not been identified. Detail (Nov 2026): Exilenova+ (Apr 4, videos attached) covers both plants burning in Tolyatti that night: KuybyshevAzot (nitrogen chemistry and polymers: ammonia, urea, ammonium nitrate) and Tolyattikauchuk (rubber).

ambargo.name: Roof fire at Moscow Higher Combined Arms Command School
ambargo.note: The roof of the Moscow Higher Combined Arms Command School is on fire. About 100 people have been evacuated. Fire area - 200 sq. m. Attribution (Nov 2026 N/A review, fifth pass): none found. Exilenova+ (Apr 5, photo attached) relays reports from what it calls hostile resources that the roof of the Moscow Higher Combined Arms Command School is burning; no attack, sabotage or claim is stated. Stays N/A.

ambargo.name: Fire at Primorsk oil terminal after drone attack
ambargo.note: Drones attack port infrastructure. Fire on the territory of the oil terminal. Attribution (Oct 2026 GS review): GS - announced by the General Staff as an operation of Defense Forces units; the executing unit was not named. The match between the statement and this exact target is approximate. Detail (Nov 2026): Militarnyi (Apr 5, map attached) says strike drones damaged a section of the oil pipeline near Primorsk port, citing the Leningrad governor, who said debris of a downed drone damaged the line during the morning repulse of 19 UAVs (ASTRA).

ambargo.name: Drone attack on Kstovo refinery damages two facilities
ambargo.note: Drones attack a refinery*. 2 facilities of the enterprise have been damaged. * The exact impact location has not been identified. Attribution (Oct 2026 GS review): GS - announced by the General Staff as an operation of Defense Forces units; the executing unit was not named. Detail (Nov 2026): the Nizhny Novgorod governor (t.me/glebnikitin_nn/8920, added) says air defence repelled an attack of 30 UAVs over the Kstovo industrial zone overnight; falling debris damaged and set on fire two facilities of Lukoil-Nizhegorodnefteorgsintez, the Novogorkovskaya CHP and several houses, and the fire was localised; Exilenova+ posted further video and photos from Kstovo and a detailed segment of the attack (videos and photos attached).

ambargo.name: Drone attack on Novogorkovskaya thermal power plant, Kstovo
ambargo.note: Drones attack the Novogorkovskaya thermal power plant*. * The exact impact location has not been identified. Attribution (Nov 2026 N/A review, fifth pass): the USF attribution made in the Oct 2026 second pass is withdrawn. It was inferred, with low confidence, only from the same town and date: the USF commander's Telegram post of Apr 5, 2026 (#2173) credits the 1st Separate Center, the 9th Battalion "Kairos" of the 414th Brigade and the 413th Regiment "Reid" (all USF) with the strike on the Lukoil refinery at Kstovo, and the General Staff confirmed the refinery hit the same day (Mind.ua), but the thermal power plant itself is not named. Stays N/A. Detail (Nov 2026): the Nizhny Novgorod governor's statement (t.me/glebnikitin_nn/8920, added) says the Novogorkovskaya CHP was damaged in the overnight attack on the Kstovo industrial zone, together with several houses, and that power supply to consumers was being restored; no photo or video of the CHP itself was found (the Kstovo videos show the refinery, so they are attached to the refinery record only).

ambargo.name: Fire at Giant shopping and entertainment center in Kaliningrad
ambargo.note: The "Giant" shopping and entertainment center is on fire. Fire area - 1500 sq. m. Attribution (Nov 2026 N/A review, fifth pass): none found. Gorod55, Snob and Fontanka (sources listed) report the large fire at the Giant shopping and entertainment centre; no attack, sabotage or claim is stated, and no Telegram post with photo or video was found. Stays N/A.

ambargo.name: Frigate Admiral Essen hit again in Novorossiysk
ambargo.note: The frigate "Admiral Essen" has been hit again. Attribution (Nov 2026 N/A review, fifth pass): the USF + SBU attribution made in the Oct 2026 second pass is withdrawn. It was inferred, with low confidence, from the same port, day and target type: the USF commander's Telegram post of Apr 6, 2026 (#2177) credits the 1st Separate Center (USF) with a drone strike on a frigate in Novorossiysk port and the SBU with planning and coordination, but names the ship Admiral Grigorovich, later corrected to Admiral Makarov, not Admiral Essen, and Kyiv Post notes that no unit claimed the Essen hit. Stays N/A. Detail (Nov 2026): Kiber Boroshno (Apr 7) says satellite imagery shows the frigate Admiral Essen was hit again in the Apr 6 attack on Novorossiysk, identified by the characteristic white colour of its radars and by Admiral Makarov remaining in the same place as after the previous attack (satellite image attached). The General Staff post of Apr 7 (t.me/GeneralStaffZSU/37007, added) records two strike UAV hits on a Russian project 11356R frigate, a Kalibr carrier, without naming the ship or a unit; method UAV follows it.

ambargo.name: Drone attack on Sheskharis oil terminal in Novorossiysk
ambargo.note: Drones attack the "Sheskharis" oil terminal. Attribution (Oct 2026 review): USF - official statement (fakty.com.ua, 2026-04-06). Detail (Nov 2026): Exilenova+ (Apr 5-6) says media material shows hits on three objects: berth No. 1 (the largest fire, from spilled oil), berth No. 2, and the metering (SIKN) and shut-off valve units that control the berths, which together mean a practical halt of loadings; on Apr 7 it counted four burning points in the Novorossiysk port from a single attack (photos attached). The General Staff post of Apr 6 (t.me/GeneralStaffZSU/36980, added) says the oil-loading infrastructure of the terminal was hit with a large fire, and its post of Apr 7 (t.me/GeneralStaffZSU/37007, added) confirms damage to the berth No. 1 and No. 2 stenders and the oil distribution and shipping pipeline system, plus 3 RVSPK-50000 tanks at the Grushovaya transshipment depot that supplies the terminal; neither names an executing unit.

ambargo.name: LSR partisans burn relay cabinet on military unit railway, Volgograd
ambargo.note: LSR partisans set fire to a relay cabinet on the railway supply route for a military unit. Detail (Nov 2026): the LSR channel says two relay cabinets on the line towards the warehouse of military unit 51473 (37th railway brigade detachment, whose task is keeping the track working for military transport) were put out of action (claim post attached). Not independently verified.

ambargo.name: Drone attack on Minudobreniya chemical plant in Rossosh
ambargo.note: Drones attack the "Minudobreniya" chemical plant. Several hits were recorded on the territory of the enterprise. Attribution (Nov 2026 N/A review, fifth pass): none found. Kiber Boroshno (Apr 6) reports several hits on the territory of the Minudobreniya plant and burning of the main fertilizer store (confirmed on video), with a risk of a large explosion; Exilenova+ posted video (attached); no unit or official Ukrainian statement found (General Staff posts of Apr 5-11 checked). Stays N/A. Detail (Nov 2026): the plant makes ammonium nitrate (about 5% of Russian output) and NPK fertilizers (about 7.5%), per Kiber Boroshno.

ambargo.name: Fire in glass factory workshop in Zhukovo
ambargo.note: A workshop of a glass factory is on fire. The fire area is 300 sq. m. Attribution (Nov 2026 N/A review, fifth pass): none found. Rambler (source listed) reports the fire at the glass factory workshop; no attack, sabotage or claim is stated, and no Telegram post with photo or video was found. Stays N/A.

ambargo.name: LSR partisans burn relay cabinet in Tver
ambargo.note: LSR partisans set fire to a relay cabinet. Detail (Nov 2026): the LSR channel says the target was the logistics of the Tver Carriage Works (Transmashholding), which it says repairs equipment damaged on the battlefield and supplies the front (claim post attached). Not independently verified.

ambargo.name: Pensioner sets fire to police station entrance in Svobodny
ambargo.note: A pensioner sets fire to the entrance of a police department. The pensioner was detained. Attribution (Nov 2026 N/A review, fifth pass): none found. RusNews (Apr 10, video attached) says police in Svobodny detained a 61-year-old local man who set fire to the entrance of the city police department in the evening and that a criminal case was opened; motives were being established. No Ukrainian unit or official claimed it. Stays N/A.

ambargo.name: Drone attack on substation at Krymskaya LPDS
ambargo.note: Drones attack an electrical substation on the territory of the linear production and dispatch station (LPDS) "Krymskaya". There is a blackout in the town. Attribution (Oct 2026 N/A review, fourth pass): SBU - LIGA.net (11 Apr 2026), citing its sources, reports that the SBU Alpha Special Operations Center hit the Krymskaya oil pumping station in Krymsk with drones in cooperation with the Unmanned Systems Forces, and that the SBU said the strike damaged infrastructure supporting the station; the General Staff announced the night of 9 Apr as work of Defense Forces units without naming one (Telegram post 37100). Matched by place and night to the station substation. Confidence: medium. Detail (Nov 2026): the General Staff post of Apr 9 (t.me/GeneralStaffZSU/37100, card attached) says Defense Forces units hit the Krymskaya oil pumping station in Krasnodar Krai overnight on Apr 9 with a fire confirmed and damage being assessed; Exilenova+ (Apr 9) says the station and the substation on its territory were attacked and locals reported a blackout (photo and videos attached).

ambargo.name: LSR partisans burn power transformer near Nizhny Novgorod
ambargo.note: LSR partisans set fire to a power transformer on the territory of an electrical substation. Detail (Nov 2026): the LSR channel says a power transformer valued at $500,000 was destroyed in the central district of Nizhny Novgorod, in an action aimed at cutting power to a number of military facilities (claim post attached). Not independently verified.

ambargo.name: SSO drones attack Korchagin field platform in Caspian Sea
ambargo.note: Special Operations Forces (SSO) drones attack a drilling rig (the field named after Korchagin). Detail (Nov 2026): the SOF post of Apr 10 (poster card attached) says SOF Deep-strike units hit two ice-resistant Lukoil drilling platforms in the northern Caspian Sea overnight on Apr 10, at the Korchagin field and at the Grayfer field (formerly Rakushechnoye), about 1,000 km from Ukraine. The General Staff post of Apr 10 (t.me/GeneralStaffZSU/37134, added) names this one as the ice-resistant fixed platform LSP-1 at the Korchagin field and does not name a unit.

ambargo.name: SSO drones attack Grayfer field platform in Caspian Sea
ambargo.note: Special Operations Forces (SSO) drones attack a drilling rig (the field named after Grayfer). Detail (Nov 2026): the SOF post of Apr 10 (poster card attached) covers both platforms: Deep-strike units of SOF hit two ice-resistant Lukoil drilling platforms in the northern Caspian Sea overnight on Apr 10, at the Grayfer field (formerly Rakushechnoye) and at the Korchagin field, about 1,000 km from Ukraine. The General Staff post of Apr 10 (t.me/GeneralStaffZSU/37134, added) names this one as the ice-resistant fixed platform LSP-2 at the Grayfer field and does not name a unit.

ambargo.name: Drones strike Tinguta oil pumping station in Volgograd Oblast
ambargo.note: Drones attack the oil pumping station "Tinguta". The Volgograd governor confirmed the attack and a fire in a tank; the number of tanks destroyed is not confirmed in the sources (the earlier text of this note, "4 RVS-20000 tanks were destroyed", was not found in any attached source). Attribution (Nov 2026 N/A review, fifth pass): none found. The Volgograd governor confirmed the attack and a fire in a tank at the station (Ukrinform, Apr 10, source added); Exilenova+ says satellite fire monitoring recorded abnormal thermal anomalies at the station and later posted a photo of the burning site (photos attached). No unit or official Ukrainian statement found (General Staff posts of Apr 5-11 checked). Stays N/A.

ambargo.name: Warehouse explosion in Vladikavkaz kills two
ambargo.note: Explosion at a warehouse. According to preliminary data, pyrotechnics were stored at the warehouse. 2 killed. More than 10 injured. Attribution (Nov 2026 N/A review, fifth pass): none found. Exilenova+ (Apr 10, video attached) reported a powerful explosion in Vladikavkaz and said details were being clarified; the warehouse and casualty details in the description above come from the original entry's sources. No attack or claim is stated. Stays N/A.

ambargo.name: Drones hit fuel tanks at Krymskaya LPDS
ambargo.note: Drones attack the linear production and dispatch station "Krymskaya". 1 fuel tank was destroyed and 2 were damaged. Attribution (Oct 2026 N/A review, fourth pass): SBU - LIGA.net (11 Apr 2026), citing its sources, reports that the SBU Alpha Special Operations Center hit the Krymskaya oil pumping station in Krymsk (second strike in about three days) with drones in cooperation with the Unmanned Systems Forces; the General Staff announced the strike of the night into 11 Apr as work of Defense Forces units without naming one (Telegram post 37182). Confidence: medium. Detail (Nov 2026): the General Staff post of Apr 11 (card attached) says Defense Forces units hit the Krymskaya oil pumping station in Krymsk and the Gvardeyskaya oil depot in occupied Crimea overnight; Radio Svoboda (Apr 13, satellite video attached) shows a fire in one tank (1) and damage to two others (2 and 3) and says its SBU source described the station as accumulating fuel, including for military needs; Exilenova+ (Apr 11) reports the repeat attack on the station (video and photo attached).

ambargo.name: Fire at Chiryurt substation in Dagestan
ambargo.note: The "Chiryurt" substation is on fire. Attribution (Nov 2026 N/A review, fifth pass): none found. Exilenova+ (Apr 11, photos attached) reports the Chiryurt 330/110/10 kV substation in Kizilyurt is burning, calling it a node substation between the 330 kV trunk grid and the regional 110 kV networks, and says the scale and cause were being clarified; no attack or claim is stated. Stays N/A.

ambargo.name: Fire in workshop at Gagarin aircraft plant in Komsomolsk-on-Amur
ambargo.note: A workshop at the aircraft plant named after Gagarin is on fire. Attribution (Nov 2026 N/A review, fifth pass): none found. Kiber Boroshno and Exilenova+ (Apr 11-14, images attached) report a fire in workshop No. 46 of the Komsomolsk-on-Amur aircraft plant (Sukhoi), which makes polymer composite parts for the Su-57 (about 300 part names); no attack, sabotage or claim is stated. Stays N/A.

ambargo.name: Atesh partisans set fire to diesel locomotive near Likhovskoy
ambargo.note: "Atesh" partisans set fire to a diesel locomotive*. * The coordinates are approximate. Detail (Nov 2026): Atesh says its agents destroyed a diesel locomotive "beyond repair" at Likhovskoy station in Rostov Oblast and calls the junction a key transit point for military cargo towards the Zaporizhzhia direction (claim post and video attached). Not independently verified.

ambargo.name: LSR partisans set fire to communications tower in Melenki
ambargo.note: LSR partisans set fire to a communications tower. Detail (Nov 2026): the LSR channel says the target was the communications and reconnaissance equipment of V/O Izotop, a Rosatom enterprise (claim post attached). Not independently verified.

ambargo.name: Drones hit Cherepovets-Azot chemical plant
ambargo.note: Drones attack the "Cherepovets-Azot" chemical plant. At least 2 workshops were hit. Detail (Nov 2026): Exilenova+ (Apr 13) says video confirms black smoke from two of the three ammonia workshops (Ammonia-1 and Ammonia-2, 900,000 tonnes a year together) and that a hit on their ammonia store, protected since 2022 by a metal structure against drones, is also reported; it puts the hit production at about 6% of Russian ammonia output (annotated image attached).

ambargo.name: Explosion at gunpowder plant in Kazan, one killed
ambargo.note: Explosion at a gunpowder plant*. 1 killed. * The exact location has not been identified. Attribution (Nov 2026 N/A review, fifth pass): none found. ASTRA (Apr 15), citing the Tatarstan head's press service, reports a collapse after the explosion at the Kazan gunpowder plant with casualties, and Exilenova+ (Apr 14) relays the authorities' comment that the cause was technogenic, there were injured, all services were on site and the production process was not stopped (images attached); no attack or claim is stated. Stays N/A.

ambargo.name: LSR partisans burn locomotive in Saint Petersburg
ambargo.note: LSR partisans set fire to a diesel locomotive. Detail (Nov 2026): the LSR channel says a rare CHME3T diesel locomotive (a modernised and costlier version of the CHME3) used to supply the front was put out of action, with its control cab burned out (claim post attached). Not independently verified.

ambargo.name: Drones attack Sintez-Kauchuk chemical plant in Sterlitamak
ambargo.note: Drones attack the "Sintez-Kauchuk" chemical plant. A large-scale fire on the territory of the enterprise. Detail (Nov 2026): Kiber Boroshno (Apr 15) places the burning at sites I-4a/I-4g of workshop I-4, which produces commercial isoprene for isoprene rubber, the plant's main product; Militarnyi (Apr 15) reports that Liutyi drones attacked the plant in the morning (images attached). The Exilenova+ post of Apr 19 (t.me/exilenova_plus/19082) formerly listed as a source was removed: it is dated four days after the attack and speaks of debris hits with smoke, with no link to the Apr 15 attack.

ambargo.name: Explosion at Kommunar plant in Petra Dubrava
ambargo.note: Explosion at the "Samarsky Zavod Kommunar" plant. Attribution (Nov 2026 N/A review, fifth pass): none found. Exilenova+ (Apr 15) says a powerful explosion sounded in the industrial zone of Samara and gives a geolocated map (image attached); no attack or claim is stated. Stays N/A.

ambargo.name: Large fire after drone attack on Tuapse oil depot
ambargo.note: Drones attack an oil depot. A large-scale fire on the territory of the enterprise. Detail (Nov 2026): Kiber Boroshno (Apr 16) groups the hit zones into three: the zone dominant at first by emissions, a second zone where several tanks caught fire and the blaze intensified through the day, and the infrastructure linking the depot to the port; the Tuapse port handles up to 25% of Russia's Black Sea oil exports (annotated images attached). The USF post of Apr 16 (t.me/usf_army/1799) says the 1st Separate Center, in cooperation with SOF, GUR, SBU and other components, attacked the Tuapse refinery; it names the refinery, not this depot, and the General Staff post of Apr 16 (t.me/GeneralStaffZSU/37380, added) likewise says the Tuapse refinery was hit with a fire confirmed, without naming a unit.

ambargo.name: Drones attack Yuzhnaya substation in Belgorod
ambargo.note: Drones attack the "Yuzhnaya" electrical substation. Attribution (Nov 2026 N/A review, fifth pass): none found. Militarnyi (Apr 16) says drones hit the Yuzhnaya substation on Gubkina Street, causing a fire, that Governor Gladkov confirmed the strike and said power was cut in parts of the city including the centre, and that the attack was first reported by the local channel Pepel; it names no party responsible and no Russian or Ukrainian military statement was found (General Staff posts of Apr 15-17 checked). Stays N/A. Detail (Nov 2026): Exilenova+ (Apr 16) posted a photo of a fire and a black smoke column at an electrical site beside a pylon during the Belgorod UAV alert; the caption does not name the substation, so the match is by place and time.

ambargo.name: LSR partisans burn relay cabinet in Tula
ambargo.note: LSR partisans set fire to a relay cabinet. Detail (Nov 2026): the LSR channel says the burned cabinet was one guarded by military unit 5580 of the Rosgvardia in Tula, which it says escorts military freight on the railways (claim post attached). Not independently verified.

ambargo.name: Drones attack Syzran refinery, large fire
ambargo.note: Drones attack an oil refinery. A large-scale fire on the territory of the enterprise. Attribution (Oct 2026 N/A review, second pass): USF + SBU + SOF + GUR - credited in the USF commander's Telegram post of 18 Apr 2026 (#2226): Syzran refinery, the Defence Forces' deep-strike units (USF, SBU, SOF, HUR and others); no single unit is named for this target, so the USF lead is inferred from the author and the joint credit. Confidence: medium. Detail (Nov 2026): Exilenova+ (Apr 18) posted video of the burning refinery (attached).

ambargo.name: Drones hit ELOU AVT-11 unit at Novokuibyshevsk refinery
ambargo.note: Drones attack an oil refinery. The ELOU AVT-11 unit was hit. A technical overpass and a tank were also damaged. Attribution (Oct 2026 N/A review, second pass): USF + SBU + SOF + GUR - credited in the USF commander's Telegram posts: the post of 18 Apr 2026 (#2226) credits the Novokuibyshevsk refinery to the Defence Forces' deep-strike units (USF, SBU, SOF, HUR and others), and his post of 24 Apr (#2255) says the refinery was hit on 18 and 23 Apr by the 1st Separate Center and the 9th Battalion "Kairos" of the 414th Brigade (USF). The posts name the refinery, not the AVT-11 unit. Confidence: high. Detail (Nov 2026): Dnipro Osint (Apr 24) satellite imagery of the Apr 18 attack shows traces of heavy burning at the AVT-11 (AVT-6) unit, which processes 6 million tonnes of oil a year; it says 80% of the plant's capacity was put out of action and that anti-drone nets over the columns did not help (image attached). The USF commander's post of Apr 24 (video attached) says the refinery was hit on Apr 18 and 23.

ambargo.name: Drones attack Tikhoretsk transshipment oil depot
ambargo.note: Drones attack a transshipment oil depot. Fire on the territory of the facility. No video or photos of the hit are available. Attribution (Oct 2026 GS review): GS - announced by the General Staff as an operation of Defense Forces units; the executing unit was not named. Detail (Nov 2026): Militarnyi (Apr 18, map card attached) says a fire broke out at the Tikhoretsk oil depot after the Ukrainian drone attack of the night of Apr 17-18, with the fire reported at 1:17 a.m.; Exilenova+ (Apr 17, source added) calls Tikhoretsk one of the largest oil transshipment points in southern Russia and posted a screenshot of the Russian emergency report (224 people and 56 units of equipment fighting the fire, no casualties).

ambargo.name: Drones attack Vysotsk port, fire at port facility
ambargo.note: Drones attack the port. Fire at one of the port infrastructure facilities*. * The exact location of the hit has not been identified. Attribution (Oct 2026 N/A review, second pass): USF + SBU + SOF + GUR - credited in the USF commander's Telegram post of 18 Apr 2026 (#2226): Vysotsk port (Lukoil-2 terminal), the Defence Forces' deep-strike units (USF, SBU, SOF, HUR and others); no single unit is named for this target, so the USF lead is inferred from the author and the joint credit. Confidence: medium. Detail (Nov 2026): Zloy Odessit (Apr 18, photo attached) says the Vysotsk port, about 1,600 km from Ukraine, hosts the Lukoil oil terminal handling fuel oil, oil, diesel and vacuum gasoil (9 million tonnes of oil products in 2025), and that Russian propagandists were trying to explain how it came under drone attack.

ambargo.name: Fire at Baltic Ship Repair Plant in Saint Petersburg
ambargo.note: Fire on the territory of the Baltic Ship Repair Plant. Attribution (Nov 2026 N/A review, fifth pass): none found. ASTRA (Apr 18), citing Fontanka, says a fire broke out in the Saint Petersburg sea port and the preliminary causes are not linked to outside interference; Supernova+ posted the same report with the coordinates 59.873474, 30.219619 (videos attached). No attack or claim is stated. Stays N/A.

ambargo.name: LSR partisans set fire to communications tower in Chapayevsk
ambargo.note: LSR partisans set fire to a communications tower. Detail (Nov 2026): the LSR channel says the target was the reconnaissance equipment of the Volga Region Test Range (FKP PGBIP: munitions testing and quality assessment, also an ammunition store) (claim post attached). Not independently verified.

ambargo.name: Neptune missile strike on Atlant Aero plant in Taganrog
ambargo.note: Neptune cruise missile strike on the "Atlant Aero" plant. Attribution (Oct 2026 GS review): GS - announced by the General Staff as an operation of Defense Forces units; the executing unit was not named. Detail (Nov 2026): Militarnyi (Apr 19, card attached) says the Defense Forces struck the Atlant Aero drone plant in Taganrog with missiles and that the plant makes Molniya airplane-type FPV kamikaze drones; Exilenova+ (Apr 24) says Sentinel-2 imagery shows damage to at least two, possibly three, plant buildings (annotated image attached).

ambargo.name: Drones attack Tuapse oil depot, large fire
ambargo.note: Drones attack an oil depot. A large-scale fire on the territory of the enterprise. Attribution (Oct 2026 review): USF + SOF + GUR - official statement (mezha.net, 2026-04-20). Detail (Nov 2026): Exilenova+ (Apr 26), quoting Oko Gora, gives the results of the drone attack on the Tuapse tank farm: 24 tanks (52%) destroyed, 4 (9%) damaged and 18 (39%) undamaged, so 61% of the tanks will be out of use soon, with no damage recorded at the neighbouring refinery (infographics attached; the post does not give the date of the attack).

ambargo.name: Drones attack armored vehicle storage of 150th Motor Rifle Division
ambargo.note: Drones attack an armored vehicle storage park on the territory of the headquarters unit of the 150th Motor Rifle Division. Attribution (Oct 2026 N/A review): GS - General Staff statement of 21 Apr 2026 reports Defence Forces units hitting logistics and materiel stores near Persianovskiy (Rostov Oblast); the executing unit was not named and the match with this armored vehicle storage is approximate. Confidence: medium. Detail (Nov 2026): Exilenova+ (Apr 21) reports a hit on the armored vehicle storage park on the territory of the headquarters unit of the 150th Guards Motor Rifle Division (military unit 22179, Persianovskiy), with geolocation (annotated imagery attached); the General Staff post of Apr 21 (card attached) lists strikes on ammunition depots and other logistics objects, and the match with this park is approximate (see attribution above).

ambargo.name: LSR partisans burn relay cabinet in Navlinsky
ambargo.note: LSR partisans set fire to a relay cabinet. Detail (Nov 2026): the LSR channel says the target was the logistics of the Navlya plant "Promsvyaz", which it says makes dual-use equipment, special communications for the army and armoured special vehicles for laying communications (claim post attached). Not independently verified.

ambargo.name: Drones destroy two tanks at Gorky pumping station in Kstovo
ambargo.note: Drones attack the oil pumping station "Gorky". Two tanks of 50,000 m³ each were destroyed, and filtration equipment and, probably, storage buildings were also damaged. Detail (Nov 2026): Exilenova+ (Apr 23, photo and videos attached) says at least one 50,000 cubic metre tank is burning at the Gorky pumping station near the village of Meshikha, Kstovo district; Dnipro Osint (May 4, via Kiber Boroshno) says satellite images show two 50,000 cubic metre tanks destroyed and damage to filtration equipment and probably storage buildings; Radio Svoboda (Apr 23) also reports the strike on the Kstovo pumping station.

ambargo.name: LSR partisans set fire to locomotive in Tolyatti
ambargo.note: LSR partisans set fire to a locomotive. Detail (Nov 2026): the LSR channel says the burned locomotive was a VL-10U ("heavy-duty") electric locomotive at Zhigulyovskoye More station in Tolyatti, used to haul heavy military trains (claim post attached). Not independently verified.

ambargo.name: Su-57 fighters and Su-34 hit at Shagol
ambargo.note: Several Su-57 fighters and a Su-34 fighter-bomber were hit. Detail (Nov 2026): the General Staff post of May 1 (card attached) says USF soldiers hit several Su-57 fighters and a Su-34 fighter-bomber at Shagol airfield (Chelyabinsk Oblast) on Apr 25, about 1,700 km from the Ukrainian border, with the degree of damage being assessed; Kiber Boroshno posted visual confirmation and InformNapalm the coordinates (images attached).

ambargo.name: Drones attack 70th GRAU arsenal near Kedrovka
ambargo.note: Drones attack the 70th GRAU arsenal. Attribution (Oct 2026 GS review): GS - announced by the General Staff as an operation of Defense Forces units; the executing unit was not named. Detail (Nov 2026): Kiber Boroshno (May 8, annotated imagery attached) says that, judging by satellite images, the hits include two bermed storages of zone No. 1 (six sections of about 18 x 12 m each, up to 1,200 sq m, fitted in 2025 with massive "mangal" anti-drone covers), the munitions-handling workshop of zone No. 2 and an open storage site; the 70th GRAU arsenal lies about 10 km from Yekaterinburg.

ambargo.name: Drones hit ELOU-AT-4 unit at Yaroslavl refinery
ambargo.note: Drones attack an oil refinery. The ELOU-AT-4 unit was hit. Attribution (Oct 2026 GS review): GS - announced by the General Staff as an operation of Defense Forces units; the executing unit was not named. Detail (Nov 2026): Kiber Boroshno (Apr 26) confirms several hits on the territory of the plant, among them the ELOU-AT-4 unit (electric desalting and atmospheric-tubular distillation, the key node of primary processing) at a refinery of over 15 million tonnes a year; Exilenova+ (Apr 25) and Dnipro Osint (May 3) posted videos (attached).

ambargo.name: LSR partisans burn relay cabinet near Vologda
ambargo.note: LSR partisans set fire to a relay cabinet. Detail (Nov 2026): the LSR channel says the action paralysed logistics on a section of the Northern Railway, at the "Dikaya" station, through which it says tonnes of trains with military and dual-use cargo pass (claim post attached). Not independently verified.

ambargo.name: Drones damage sulfuric acid pipeline at Cherepovets-Azot
ambargo.note: Drones attack the "Cherepovets-Azot" chemical plant*. A high-pressure sulfuric acid pipeline was damaged. * The exact location of the hit has not been identified. Attribution (Oct 2026 N/A review, second pass): USF - credited in the USF commander's Telegram post of 26 Apr 2026 (#2266): Cherepovets chemical plant, 1st Separate Center and the 9th Battalion "Kairos" of the 414th Brigade (USF). The post does not mention the sulfuric acid pipeline, and the SOF credit in the same post applies to the Yaroslavl refinery only. Confidence: high. Detail (Nov 2026): Filimonov LIVE (relayed by Exilenova+, Apr 26; card attached) says a UAV damaged a high-pressure sulfuric-acid pipeline at the Ammiak-3 unit of the Apatit nitrogen complex, with no fire, air measurements showing no excess of limits and, preliminarily, 5 people burned by the acid and hospitalised in Vologda; ASTRA (Apr 26) adds that the Cherepovets authorities first called the video of the Apr 13 attack a fake and made the people who filmed it apologise on camera.

ambargo.name: Drones attack Tuapse refinery, at least four tanks burning
ambargo.note: Drones attack an oil refinery. Burning of at least 4 tanks was recorded. Attribution (Oct 2026 GS review): GS - announced by the General Staff as an operation of Defense Forces units; the executing unit was not named. Detail (Nov 2026): Kiber Boroshno (Apr 28, image attached) says at least 4 tanks are burning at the refinery itself, unlike earlier attacks that hit the tank farm, and gives coordinates of the confirmed hit points, with a chance of the fire spreading to neighbouring tanks; Exilenova+ (Apr 28) says Tuapse was flaring up again after that day's attack.

ambargo.name: LSR partisans burn EW communications tower near military airfield
ambargo.note: LSR partisans set fire to a communications tower with electronic warfare (EW) antennas near a military airfield. Detail (Nov 2026): the LSR channel says it struck reconnaissance means and EW antennas covering the Uktus airfield, now used as a rear helicopter site for training and repairs (claim post attached). Not independently verified.

ambargo.name: Mi-28 and Mi-8 helicopters hit at forward site in Voronezh Oblast
ambargo.note: Two helicopters, a Mi-28 and a Mi-8 (named Mi-17 in the Ukrainian posts), were hit by drones at a field landing site in Voronezh Oblast on Apr 29. Dosye Shpiona says both were damaged, not destroyed; the earlier text of this record said destroyed. Detail (Nov 2026): the USF commander's post of Apr 29 (poster card attached) says the strike was made by combined crews of the 429th Brigade "Achilles" and the 43rd Separate Artillery Brigade, jointly with the SBU Alpha Center, on a field landing site more than 150 km from the front line in Voronezh Oblast, hitting the rear engine compartment of the helicopters. Dosye Shpiona (May 14) says two UAVs hit two helicopters at the "Ozero" forward site: a Mi-8 (tail no. 60) of the 41st helicopter regiment (Buturlinovka) and a Mi-28 (tail no. 07) of the 15th army aviation brigade, and that two officers of the 15th brigade were wounded. The Ukrainian posts name the site only as a field landing site in Voronezh Oblast; the Rossosh location comes from the original entry and is not confirmed by the sources. Kiber Boroshno posted images (attached).

ambargo.name: Drones attack Nebo-M radar near Ukolovo
ambargo.note: Drones attack the "Nebo-M" radar. Attribution (Oct 2026 N/A review, second pass): USF - credited in the USF commander's Telegram post of 1 May 2026 (#2292): "Nebo-M" radar at Ukolovo, 429th Separate Brigade "Achilles" (USF); the post names the same radar at the same village and is dated two days after this record. Confidence: high. Detail (Nov 2026): the 429th Brigade "Achilles" post of Apr 29 (video attached) says its crews hit the Nebo-M radar at Ukolovo (almost 100 km from the Ukrainian border, at the Belgorod-Kursk oblast junction), striking the most vulnerable part of the complex.

ambargo.name: Drones attack Perm oil pumping station, tanks burning
ambargo.note: Drones attack the oil pumping station "Perm". At least 2 fuel tanks are burning. Detail (Nov 2026): Radio Svoboda (Apr 29, video attached) says the SBU stated it hit the Russian oil pumping station near Perm, more than 1,500 km from Ukraine, with nearly all storage tanks burning; Exile+ (Apr 30, photo attached) confirms that as of 13:15 on Apr 30 at least 4 tanks of 50,000 cubic metres each were destroyed or burning, a total of 200,000 cubic metres of commercial oil.

ambargo.name: LSR partisans burn power transformer in Solyanka
ambargo.note: LSR partisans set fire to a power transformer on the territory of an electrical substation. Detail (Nov 2026): the LSR channel says it disrupted pilot training at the Privolzhsky airfield training and combat centre (MiG-29SMT trainers) (claim post attached). Not independently verified.

ambargo.name: Drones hit AVT-4 unit at LUKOIL-Permnefteorgsintez refinery
ambargo.note: Drones attack an oil refinery. The AVT-4 unit was hit. Detail (Nov 2026): Exilenova+ (Apr 30, image attached) says media material confirms a Liutyi UAV hit on the AVT-4 unit, in particular its vacuum column, with the fire spreading to the atmospheric column; it says hitting both columns effectively disables the unit.

ambargo.name: Drones hit two explosives workshops at Sverdlov plant in Dzerzhinsk
ambargo.note: Drones attack the plant named after Sverdlov. 2 explosives production workshops were hit. Attribution (Oct 2026 GS review): GS - announced by the General Staff as an operation of Defense Forces units; the executing unit was not named. Detail (Nov 2026): Kiber Boroshno (May 5, image attached) says two An-196 Liutyi UAVs hit two explosives production workshops of the plant (a producer of TNT, RDX and HMX), despite three Pantsir-S1 systems covering the site, and that both hit workshops have massive earth embankments.

ambargo.name: Drones attack oil depot in Tuapse
ambargo.note: Drones attack an oil depot. Detail (Nov 2026): Kiber Boroshno (May 1) calls it the 4th round of drone arrivals at the tank farm of the oil export port overnight on May 1; from the burning video and satellite imagery of Apr 28 it geolocates the fire in a zone of four 10,000 cubic metre tanks, at least 2 of them burning on a conservative estimate, and says the pumping station in that section was destroyed, so the fire may cover about 40,000 cubic metres with another 30,000-60,000 at risk (annotated images attached).

ambargo.name: Fire at high-voltage substation in Kanash
ambargo.note: Fire on the territory of a high-voltage electrical substation. Attribution (Nov 2026 N/A review, fifth pass): none found. ASTRA (May 2) says its OSINT analysis of eyewitness video places the fire at the 220 kV substation "Kanash" (Zheleznodorozhnaya St. 263); residents reported explosions beforehand and there was no official information (photos attached). No attack, sabotage or claim is stated. Stays N/A.

ambargo.name: Fire at energy sales company office in Alatyr
ambargo.note: The office building of the energy sales company "Alatyrskoe MO ChESK" is on fire. Attribution (Nov 2026 N/A review, fifth pass): none found. ASTRA (May 2) says its OSINT analysis of eyewitness video places the fire at the office of the energy sales company "Alatyrskoe MO ChESK" (Zhukovskogo St. 55), the second of two fires reported in Chuvashia that night (video and photo attached). No attack, sabotage or claim is stated. Stays N/A.

ambargo.name: Karakurt missile ship hit at Primorsk
ambargo.note: The missile ship "Karakurt" was hit*. * The exact location of the hit has not been identified. Detail (Nov 2026): the statement of May 3 (source listed) says the missile ship "Karakurt", a patrol boat and one more shadow-fleet tanker were hit at Primorsk in a joint operation of the SBU, the USF, SOF, GUR and the border guards, with significant damage also done to the infrastructure of the oil-loading port; it does not say where on the ship the hit was or by what weapon.

ambargo.name: Patrol boat hit at Primorsk
ambargo.note: A patrol boat was hit*. * The exact location of the hit has not been identified. Detail (Nov 2026): the statement of May 3 (source listed) lists a patrol boat among the targets hit at Primorsk in the joint operation of the SBU, the USF, SOF, GUR and the border guards; it gives no hit location or weapon.

ambargo.name: Drones attack oil port infrastructure at Primorsk
ambargo.note: Drones attack the infrastructure of an oil loading port*. * The exact location of the hit has not been identified. Detail (Nov 2026): the statement of May 3 (source listed) says significant damage was done to the infrastructure of the oil-loading port at Primorsk, together with a Karakurt missile ship, a patrol boat and a shadow-fleet tanker; the attached image is a satellite fire map dated May 3 posted with that statement.

ambargo.name: Shadow fleet tanker hit at Primorsk
ambargo.note: A shadow fleet tanker was hit*. * The exact location of the hit has not been identified. Detail (Nov 2026): the statement of May 3 (source listed) says one more tanker of the shadow oil fleet was hit at Primorsk, in addition to the missile ship and the patrol boat; it gives no hit location or weapon.

ambargo.name: Flamingo strike on VNIIR-Progress institute in Cheboksary
ambargo.note: FP-5 "Flamingo" missile strike on the research institute "VNIIR-Progress". Attribution (Nov 2026 review): GS - the General Staff statement of May 5 (card attached) says Defense Forces units hit the "VNIIR-Progress" plant in Cheboksary overnight on May 5 (it makes GNSS receivers and antennas, including "Kometa" adaptive antenna arrays used in Shahed-type drones, cruise and ballistic missiles and glide-and-correction kits for aerial bombs); it does not name the executing unit or the weapon. This replaces the earlier GS attribution, which rested only on a statement by the President.
