Detail (Nov 2026): the Chernaya Iskra channel says two tank cars with 140 tonnes of specialised mineral oil (about 100 million rubles), meant for military equipment, were blown up on the Agryz - Kruglloye Pole - Akbash line, that no air-raid alert was declared during the action, and that its logo is visible on two explosive devices in the video (claim post and video attached). Not independently verified.

ambargo.name: LSR partisans burn electronic warfare communications tower in Almetyevsk
ambargo.note: LSR partisans are setting fire to a communications tower with an electronic warfare module. Detail (Nov 2026): the LSR channel says it disabled the equipment of a communications tower with an EW module at the needed moment, to ease the drones' route to the February strike on the Kaleikino pumping station (a node of the Druzhba pipeline) together with other air-defence neutralisation around Almetyevsk (claim post attached). Not independently verified.

ambargo.name: Drone attack on Metafrax Chemicals plant in Gubakha
ambargo.note: Drones are attacking the "Metafrax Chemicals" chemical plant. Detail (Nov 2026): Exilenova+ (May 23, videos and photos attached) says local residents report an attack on the Metafrax chemical plant in Gubakha, which was already attacked earlier and was hit again that day; the attached screenshot of the Perm Krai governor's statement says several UAVs were shot down on approach by MoD forces and mobile fire groups, with no casualties.

ambargo.name: Fire at Irgiredmet research institute in Irkutsk
ambargo.note: The "Irgiredmet" research institute is on fire. The fire area is 700 sq m. Attribution (Nov 2026 N/A review, fifth pass): none found. Exilenova+ (May 23, videos attached) reports a fire at the Irgiredmet research centre (technologies for extracting and processing gold and rare and precious metals); no attack, sabotage or claim is stated. Stays N/A.

ambargo.name: Drone attack on Tamanneftegaz terminal at Taman port
ambargo.note: Drones are attacking the "Tamanneftegaz" terminal. Attribution (Oct 2026 GS review): GS - announced by the General Staff as an operation of Defense Forces units; the executing unit was not named. Detail (Nov 2026): the General Staff statement of May 24 (card attached) says the oil-loading berth of the Tamanneftegaz terminal in Volna was hit on May 23 and overnight on May 24, with the oil-loading stand preliminarily damaged (the terminal handles up to 20 million tonnes of oil and products a year).

ambargo.name: Drone attack on Vtorovo oil pumping station near Kameshkovo
ambargo.note: Drones are attacking the "Vtorovo" oil pumping station*. * The exact point of impact has not been identified. Attribution (Oct 2026 N/A review, fourth pass): SBU - Slovo i Dilo (24 May 2026) reports that SBU drones hit an oil pumping station in Vladimir Oblast that supplies fuel to the Moscow region; matched to the Vtorovo station by oblast, date and facility type, because the station name was not confirmed in the report. Confidence: medium. Detail (Nov 2026): Exilenova+ (May 24, photo attached) says the Defense Forces attacked the Vtorovo pumping station of Transneft, an intermediate oil product pumping station that is a key node for fuel transport towards central Russia, and later posted photos and videos of the station after a raid by deep-strike drones of the SBU Alpha Special Operations Center.

ambargo.name: Fire at retail pavilion in Moscow
ambargo.note: A retail pavilion is on fire. The fire area is 1500 sq m.

ambargo.name: Probable sabotage at IntekKhim oil depot in Kandry
ambargo.note: The "IntekKhim" oil depot is on fire. Probably sabotage. Attribution (Nov 2026 N/A review, fifth pass): none found. Rospartizan (May 26, photos attached; they carry a Russian emergency ministry logo) says the IntekKhim oil depot in Kandry, Bashkortostan, was burned, with eight tanks burned, and presents it as the kind of ground operation that should complement air strikes, but does not say who did it; no unit or group claim was found. Stays N/A.

ambargo.name: LSR partisans burn relay cabinet in Novouralsk
ambargo.note: LSR partisans are burning a relay cabinet. Detail (Nov 2026): the LSR channel says it hit several relay cabinets, disrupting the supply chain of the Ural Electrochemical Combine (UEKhK, Rosatom, uranium enrichment) (claim post attached). Not independently verified.

ambargo.name: Storm Shadow strike on Taganrog airfield communications battalion
ambargo.note: Strike with Storm Shadow cruise missiles on the territory of the airfield. Destruction in the area where the communications and radio-technical support battalion is located. Attribution (Oct 2026 GS review): GS - Air Force (General Staff statement, 27 May 2026; Storm Shadow missiles). Detail (Nov 2026): the General Staff statement of May 28 (card attached) says Air Force units used Storm Shadow air-launched missiles to hit software and hardware reconnaissance-automation complexes of the Russian Air Force around Voronezh, Taganrog and Sevastopol; Kiber Boroshno (May 27, video attached) says the strike hit and destroyed buildings at the location of the communications and radio-technical support battalion of Taganrog Central airfield.

ambargo.name: Drone attack on Tuapse refinery
ambargo.note: Drones are attacking the Tuapse oil refinery. Fire on the enterprise's territory. Attribution (Nov 2026 review): USF - the USF commander's May list (t.me/robert_magyar/2417, May 29) includes "27 May TUAPSE 5.0 (Krasnodar Krai)" among the 17 oil targets hit by USF drones in May; the General Staff statement of May 28 (card attached) names the Tuapse refinery as hit by Defense Forces units overnight on May 27. This replaces the earlier GS attribution, made while the record did not name the plant. Detail (Nov 2026): the General Staff statement of May 28 (card attached) says the Tuapse refinery (about 12 million tonnes a year) was hit overnight on May 27 with a fire and smoke recorded and the extent of damage being clarified; Exilenova+ (May 27, photos and video attached) says locals reported at least one arrival in Tuapse that night.

ambargo.name: Fire at furniture warehouse in Dolgoprudny
ambargo.note: A furniture warehouse is on fire. The fire area is 4700 sq m. Attribution (Nov 2026 N/A review, fifth pass): none found. ASTRA (May 27, photos attached), citing the emergency ministry, says the furniture warehouse fire in Dolgoprudny, near Sheremetyevo airport, spread over 4,700 sq m and was localised, with the cause unknown; no attack or claim is stated. Stays N/A.

ambargo.name: Drone hits court building in Nizhny Novgorod
ambargo.note: A drone hit a court building. Attribution (Nov 2026 N/A review, fifth pass): none found. Exilenova+ (May 28, video and photo attached) says EW was triggered and local residents write that a drone flew into the Nizhny Novgorod regional court building; no official claim was found. Stays N/A.

ambargo.name: Chernaya Iskra partisans set fire to locomotive in Novosergiyevka
ambargo.note: Chernaya Iskra partisans are setting fire to a diesel locomotive*. * The exact location has not been identified. The coordinates are conditional. Detail (Nov 2026): the Chernaya Iskra channel says that, after burning the electric locomotive VL10-1731 in Chelyabinsk, its next episode was damage to a main-line diesel locomotive at Novosergiyevskaya station in Orenburg Oblast, again disrupting a military cargo train (claim post and video attached). Not independently verified.

ambargo.name: LSR partisans burn transformer at TEKHOS plant in Yegoryevsk
ambargo.note: LSR partisans are burning a transformer on the territory of the "TEKHOS" plant. Detail (Nov 2026): the LSR channel says it burned a substation transformer at the TEKHOS plant (locomotive components), leaving the plant without electricity (claim post attached). Not independently verified.

ambargo.name: Drone attack on Lukoil refinery in Volgograd
ambargo.note: Drones are attacking the oil refinery. Fire on the enterprise's territory*. * The exact point of impact has not been identified. Attribution (Nov 2026 review): USF + SOF + GUR + SBU - the USF post of May 29 (t.me/DIUkraine/8578, poster card attached) says operators of the 1st Separate Center and the 414th Brigade "Madyar's Birds" of the USF, in cooperation with SOF, GUR, SBU and other components of the Defense Forces, struck the Lukoil-Volgogradneftepererabotka plant overnight on May 29. This replaces the earlier GS attribution, which rested only on the General Staff statement. Detail (Nov 2026): the General Staff statement of May 29 (card attached) says the Volgograd refinery (Lukoil, about 14 million tonnes a year) was hit with a fire recorded, that the AVT-1, AVT-3, AVT-5 and AVT-6 primary distillation units and secondary processing units were hit, and that the plant stopped its production processes.

ambargo.name: Drone attack on Yaroslavl-3 pumping station near Gavrilov-Yam
ambargo.note: Drones are attacking the "Yaroslavl-3" oil pumping station. Attribution (Oct 2026 GS review): GS - announced by the General Staff as an operation of Defense Forces units; the executing unit was not named. Detail (Nov 2026): the General Staff statement of May 29 (card attached) says the "Yaroslavl-3" station was hit with a fire recorded and the burning of two oil tanks, of 50,000 and 20,000 cubic metres, confirmed; it calls the station a node of the Surgut-Polotsk pipeline that carries oil from Siberia and the north of Russia to the Baltic ports of Primorsk and Ust-Luga and to Belarus, part of Transneft.

ambargo.name: Iskander missile system hit near Neklinovskiy
ambargo.note: The "Iskander" OTRK (operational-tactical missile system) was hit. Detail (Nov 2026): Kiber Boroshno (May 30, image attached) says the Iskander OTRK was hit near Mikhailovka and Yefremovsky in Rostov Oblast, about 30 km from Taganrog and 145 km from the front line; the General Staff statement of May 30 (card attached) confirms a hit on an Iskander-M launcher in the Taganrog area, the degree of damage being clarified; the USF commander's post of May 30 (t.me/robert_magyar/2420) counts the Iskander and two Tu-142 among the 23 targets worked by USF drones overnight, so the method is corrected from MISSILE to UAV (the earlier value described the target, not the weapon).

ambargo.name: Two Tu-142 aircraft destroyed at Beriev complex in Taganrog
ambargo.note: On the territory of the Beriev Aviation Scientific and Technical Complex, 2 Tu-142 anti-submarine aircraft were destroyed. Detail (Nov 2026): Exilenova+ (May 31, image attached) posts post-strike reconnaissance of the 2 Tu-142 hit by forces of the 1st Separate Center on the Taganrog airfield on May 30; the General Staff statement of May 30 (card attached) confirms a hit on two Tu-142 in the Taganrog area, the degree of damage being clarified; the USF commander's post of May 30 (t.me/robert_magyar/2420) counts them among the 23 targets worked by USF drones overnight.

ambargo.name: Drone attack on oil tanker in Taganrog
ambargo.note: Drones are attacking an oil tanker. Detail (Nov 2026): Exilenova+ (May 30, poster card attached) posted the video of the burning tanker; the USF commander's post of May 30 lists a shadow-fleet oil tanker among the night's 23 targets in the operational depth, without naming a port.

ambargo.name: Drone attack on Kurgannefteprodukt oil depot in Taganrog
ambargo.note: Drones are attacking the "Kurgannefteprodukt" oil depot. Detail (Nov 2026): the USF commander's post of May 30 (poster card attached) credits the "Birds" of the 1st Separate Center with the Kurgannefteprodukt depot in Taganrog, one of 23 targets in the operational depth that night, coordinated by the newly created USF Deep Strike Center; the General Staff statement of May 30 (card attached) says the terminal in Taganrog was hit and a fuel tank damaged, other results being clarified.

ambargo.name: Drone attack on Yuzhnaya Neftyanaya Kompaniya oil depot in Armavir
ambargo.note: Drones are attacking the "Yuzhnaya Neftyanaya Kompaniya" oil depot. Detail (Nov 2026): Exilenova+ (May 30, video and screenshot attached) says Yuzhnaya Neftyanaya Kompaniya LLC in Armavir was attacked overnight; the attached screenshot of a local emergency channel says the fire on the territory of an oil depot caused by a UAV attack was localised, with no casualties.

ambargo.name: Drone attack on Saratov refinery, ELOU-AVT-6 and tanks hit
ambargo.note: Drones are attacking the oil refinery. ELOU-AVT-6, several tanks and process pipe racks have been hit. Attribution (Oct 2026 review): USF - USF monthly summary (fakty.com.ua, 2026-05-31). Detail (Nov 2026): the General Staff statement of May 31 (card attached) says the Saratov refinery (Rosneft, about 7 million tonnes a year) was hit with a large fire confirmed; Kiber Boroshno (May 31, image attached) counts at least three confirmed hits, on the ELOU-AVT-6 unit and on two tanks, and Exilenova+ (May 31, image attached) adds visual signs of hits on the visbreaking section and process pipe racks and says the plant's work was probably partly or fully halted.

ambargo.name: Neptune missile strike on Novoshakhtinsk refinery
ambargo.note: Strike with Neptune cruise missiles on the oil refinery*. 2 oil processing units have been put out of action. * The exact point of impact has not been identified. Attribution (Oct 2026 GS review): GS - Navy (Neptune missiles) per the Militarnyi headline of the record source; no General Staff statement found for this strike.

ambargo.name: Drone attack on Lazarevo linear production and dispatch station
ambargo.note: Drones are attacking the "Lazarevo" linear production and dispatch station. Attribution (Oct 2026 GS review): GS - announced by the General Staff as an operation of Defense Forces units; the executing unit was not named. Detail (Nov 2026): the General Staff statement of May 31 (card attached) says the Lazarevo linear production and dispatch station in Kirov Oblast, which pumps crude through the Surgut-Gorky-Polotsk trunk pipeline, was hit; Dnipro Osint (May 31, photo attached) says the footage probably shows two neighbouring RVS-50000 tanks burning, with up to 100,000 cubic metres of oil at risk; Exilenova+ (May 31, photos attached) gives the distance from the state border as about 1,200 km.

ambargo.name: Drone attack on oil depot in Matveyev Kurgan
ambargo.note: Drones are attacking an oil depot. An emergency situation regime has been introduced. Attribution (Oct 2026 GS review): GS - announced by the General Staff as an operation of Defense Forces units; the executing unit was not named. Detail (Nov 2026): the General Staff statement of May 31 (card attached) says a fuel and lubricants depot in Matveyev Kurgan, Rostov Oblast, was hit; Exilenova+ (May 30-31, photos and videos attached) says the Defense Forces' strike UAVs probably hit the oil depot at Matveyev Kurgan/Taganrog.

ambargo.name: LSR partisans burn relay cabinet in Lipetsk
ambargo.note: LSR partisans are burning a relay cabinet. Detail (Nov 2026): the LSR channel says a participant disrupted the rail line through Lipetsk, which it says carries regular shipments of ammunition, equipment and personnel, halting shipments for an indefinite period (claim post attached). Not independently verified.

ambargo.name: Drone attack on Balakhonikha oil pumping station near Ardatov
ambargo.note: Drones are attacking the "Balakhonikha" oil pumping station. Attribution (Nov 2026 N/A review, fifth pass): none found. Exilenova+ (June 1) posted satellite images that show two buildings of the pumping station significantly damaged by the strike; no unit or official claim was found in the General Staff posts of May 31-July 6 or in the SBU, SOF and USF posts checked. Stays N/A.

ambargo.name: Drone attack on Ilsky refinery
ambargo.note: Drones are attacking the oil refinery. Fire on the enterprise's territory. Detail (Nov 2026): Exilenova+ (June 2, videos and photo attached) posted the moment of the attack and more footage of arrivals at the Ilsky refinery; the General Staff statement of June 2 (card attached) says the refinery, one of the largest in the south of Russia with about 6.6 million tonnes a year of capacity, was hit and a fire on the site confirmed, the scale of damage being clarified.

ambargo.name: Drone attack on railway infrastructure in Unecha
ambargo.note: Drones are attacking railway infrastructure*. * The coordinates are approximate. Attribution (Nov 2026 N/A review, fifth pass): none found. Exilenova+ (June 2, video and photos attached; the photos from Dzhankoy in Crimea are left out) says Defense Forces strike UAVs hit railway infrastructure in Unecha; no unit or official claim was found. The USF commander's post of June 29 (t.me/robert_magyar/2535) lists a locomotive at Unecha among its June targets but gives no date, so it cannot be tied to this record. Stays N/A.

ambargo.name: Fire at Melzavod EGA after drone attack in Alekseyevka
ambargo.note: Fire on the territory of "Melzavod EGA" LLC after a drone attack. Attribution (Nov 2026 N/A review, fifth pass): none found. Exilenova+ (June 2, videos attached) says Alekseyevka was attacked before dawn and a fire started on the Melzavod EGA site; no unit or official claim was found, and the missile strike on the same plant on June 23 (a separate record) is unclaimed too. Stays N/A.

ambargo.name: Corvette Boikiy hit in Saint Petersburg
ambargo.note: The corvette "Boikiy" has been hit. Detail (Nov 2026): the General Staff statement of June 3 (card attached) says Defense Forces units hit a project 20380 corvette in Kronstadt overnight, preliminarily the "Boikiy", with a large fire confirmed on board; the SBU statement of June 3 (card attached) says Ukrainian drones also worked the warships based at the Kronstadt naval base in the same operation as the strike on the Saint Petersburg oil terminal; Dosye Shpiona (June 4, video attached) posted the aftermath, naming the 128th Surface Ship Brigade of the Baltic Fleet.

ambargo.name: Drone attack on oil terminal in Saint Petersburg
ambargo.note: Drones are attacking an oil terminal. Fire on the enterprise's territory. Attribution (Nov 2026 review): SBU + USF + SOF + GUR - the SBU statement of June 3 (card attached) says the SBU, together with the Unmanned Systems Forces, the Special Operations Forces, the Border Guard Service and the GUR, struck the Saint Petersburg oil terminal, about 1,100 km from the border, with at least four separate large fires in the tank farm. This replaces the earlier GS attribution, which treated the SBU involvement as unconfirmed. Detail (Nov 2026): Exilenova+ (June 3, videos attached) posted the moment of the attack on one of the tanks and further arrivals; Cxemu (June 3, satellite image attached) shows a large fire on the terminal territory on a Planet Labs image of June 3 and quotes the USF commander's comment that the drones came in under the cover of the white nights; the General Staff statement of June 3 (card attached) records a fire after the hit (throughput 10 million tonnes a year).

ambargo.name: Drone attack on Progress plant in Michurinsk
ambargo.note: Drones are attacking the "Progress" plant. Attribution (Oct 2026 GS review): GS - announced by the General Staff as an operation of Defense Forces units; the executing unit was not named. Detail (Nov 2026): Exilenova+ (June 2, videos attached) relayed reports of arrivals at the plant, which makes control equipment for aircraft and missile systems; Astra (June 2, video attached) geolocated eyewitness video of the fire; the General Staff statement of June 3 (card attached) says the plant, which makes components of precision weapons, was hit and a fire recorded, the scale of losses being clarified.

ambargo.name: Explosion and fire at weapons production facility in Tula, 2 dead
ambargo.note: Explosion and large-scale fire on the territory of a weapons production facility. 2 dead. Attribution (Nov 2026 N/A review, fifth pass): none found. Astra (June 3, video attached) cites local channels that an explosion and fire on Lenin Avenue in Tula killed two people and says the burning site is a weapons production facility; the sources name no cause and no unit, and no claim was found. Stays N/A.

ambargo.name: Chernaya Iskra partisans blow up VL-80 locomotive in Kinel
ambargo.note: Chernaya Iskra partisans are blowing up a VL-80 electric locomotive. Detail (Nov 2026): the Chernaya Iskra channel says its cell in Samara blew up the VL-80 main-line electric locomotive at Kinel station with a homemade bomb planted under the oil tank of its cooling system; it says the locomotive regularly delivered ammunition, equipment and fuel to air defense units of the region, in particular the 340th radiotechnical regiment (military unit 40278) (claim post attached). Not independently verified.

ambargo.name: Drone attack destroys workshop at Elastik plant in Lisove
ambargo.note: Drones are attacking the "Elastik" plant. One of the workshops has been destroyed. Attribution (Oct 2026 GS review): GS - announced by the General Staff as an operation of Defense Forces units; the executing unit was not named. Detail (Nov 2026): the General Staff statement of June 4 (card attached) says the Elastik gunpowder plant, a branch of "Gefest-M" in Ryazan Oblast, was hit and a fire started on more than 400 sq m; Astra (June 9, video attached), citing Radio Svoboda, says satellite images of June 6-8 show at least one building seriously damaged after the Ukrainian attack of June 4.

ambargo.name: Drone attack on Russian Navy 15th arsenal near Bolshaya Izhora
ambargo.note: Drones are attacking the 15th arsenal of the Russian Navy. The total amount of lost property is about 5000 tonnes. Detail (Nov 2026): the SBU statement of June 6 (card attached) says the SBU Alpha center, together with the Armed Forces and the GUR, hit the 15th arsenal of the Russian Navy in Leningrad Oblast, with a fire and secondary detonation, missiles and ammunition stored there, and a possible evacuation of nearby villages; Dosye Shpiona (June 7, source) says about 40 strike UAVs were used, 32 of them shot down, and the above-ground hangar stores detonated, with about 5,000 tonnes of property lost; the General Staff statement of June 6 (card attached) lists the arsenal among the Leningrad Oblast targets hit. The USF commander's post of June 6 credits the whole Leningrad Oblast operation to USF units together with SOF, SBU and GUR without naming the arsenal separately, so USF and SOF are added as co-units. Atesh (June 6, photo attached) says its agents reconnoitred the military depots burning in Leningrad Oblast (it names military unit 81263, the 7082nd naval mine-torpedo base) and passed the data on to the Defense Forces; it does not name the arsenal, so it is not applied.

ambargo.name: Drone attack on Baltic Fleet base Kronstadt
ambargo.note: Drones are attacking the Baltic Fleet naval base "Kronstadt"*. Fire on the territory of the base. * The exact point of impact has not been identified. Detail (Nov 2026): the SOF statement of June 6 (relayed by InformNapalm, photo attached) says SOF Deep Strike drones, together with the USF and the SBU, hit the Kronstadt naval base overnight, several SOF drones reaching their targets with a fire recorded; the USF commander's post of June 6 (photo attached) credits the Leningrad Oblast operation to units of the 1st Separate Center, the 9th Kairos battalion of the 414th Brigade, the 413th Raid regiment and the 412th Nemesis brigade of the USF jointly with SOF, SBU and GUR; the SBU statement of June 6 (card attached) records a fire near the base and the Kronstadt Marine Plant; the General Staff statement of June 6 (card attached) records explosions at the base, the degree of damage being clarified; Exilenova+ (June 6, video attached) posted footage from Kronstadt.

ambargo.name: Drone attack on oil depot in Ust-Labinsk, large fire
ambargo.note: Drones are attacking an oil depot. Large-scale fire on the enterprise's territory. The fire area is about 5,000 sq m. Detail (Nov 2026): the SBU statement of June 6 (card attached) says a series of explosions at the Ust-Labinsk oil depot was followed by a large fire covering at least three tanks; Exilenova+ (June 6, videos attached) posted footage from local residents; Dnipro Osint (June 8, photo attached) confirms at least 6 destroyed tanks, with the northern part and one more fire seat in question and 3 tanks in the south-west certainly intact; Kiber Boroshno (June 6, image attached) puts the attack at about 03:20 and says the scale of the fire prevents an exact count of the hit tanks.

ambargo.name: Fire at Tyumen refinery treatment unit
ambargo.note: Fire on the territory of the oil refinery. One of the treatment system units is on fire. Attribution (Nov 2026 N/A review, fifth pass): none found. Astra (June 6, video attached) says the authorities state the fire at one of the treatment system units was caused by a violation of the technological process and not by a drone attack; Exilenova+ (June 6, video attached) posted footage of the fire, and no claim was found. Stays N/A.

ambargo.name: Drone hits UAV center hangar at Prostasovo airfield
ambargo.note: A drone is attacking the "Prostasovo" airfield. A hangar of the scientific and production center for the development and manufacture of UAVs has been hit. Attribution (Nov 2026 N/A review, fifth pass): none found. Dosye Shpiona and Kiber Boroshno (June 8, videos and photos attached) posted the attack on the airfield, damage unknown, noting that a scientific and production center for developing and making UAVs is reported on its territory; Astra (June 8, photos attached) says the video it analysed shows Ukrainian drones striking the airfield; no unit or official claim was found. Stays N/A.

ambargo.name: Drone attack and fire at Grushovaya oil depot in Novorossiysk
ambargo.note: Drones are attacking the "Grushovaya" transshipment oil depot. Fire on the enterprise's territory*. * The exact point of impact has not been identified. Attribution (Nov 2026 review): USF + SOF - the USF commander's list of June 10 (t.me/robert_magyar/2464) credits the Grushovaya hub on June 8 to the 1st Separate Center of the USF, SOF and other Defense Forces units, and the SOF statement of June 8 (card attached) says SOF Deep Strike units hit the station overnight. This replaces the earlier GS attribution, which rested only on the General Staff statement. Detail (Nov 2026): the SOF statement of June 8 (photo attached) says SOF Deep Strike units hit the Grushovaya oil pumping station of the Sheskharis transshipment complex in Novorossiysk overnight; the USF commander's post of June 8 (photo attached) calls it the biggest oil depot in the south of Russia, with 1.2-1.4 million tonnes of tank capacity; the General Staff statement of June 8 (card attached) records a fire, and its statement of June 10 (t.me/GeneralStaffZSU/39771) confirms two burning oil tanks and infrastructure used to assess oil product quality; Exilenova+ (June 7-8, videos and photos attached) posted the attack footage and the coordinates.

ambargo.name: Drone attack on Krasnyy Yar linear production and dispatch station
ambargo.note: Drones are attacking the "Krasnyy Yar" linear production and dispatch station. Attribution (Nov 2026 review): SOF - the SOF statement of June 8 (card attached) says SOF Deep Strike drones hit the Krasny Yar station in a series of drone strikes overnight. This replaces the earlier GS attribution, which rested only on the General Staff statement. Detail (Nov 2026): the SOF statement of June 8 (photo attached) says SOF Deep Strike drones hit the Krasny Yar linear production and dispatch station, a node of two trunk oil pipelines of the state company Transneft more than 500 km from the border, and started a fire; the General Staff statement of June 8 (card attached) records the fire, and its statement of June 10 (t.me/GeneralStaffZSU/39771) confirms one burning 50,000 cubic metre oil tank; Exilenova+ (June 8, photo attached) says local authorities confirmed the attack.

ambargo.name: Chernaya Iskra partisans disable Valdai-Pskov-Riga gas pipeline
ambargo.note: Chernaya Iskra partisans are disabling the strategic "Valdai-Pskov-Riga" gas pipeline*. * The exact location has not been identified. The coordinates are conditional. Detail (Nov 2026): the Chernaya Iskra channel says it blew up the Valdai-Pskov-Riga trunk gas pipeline, which passes near Staraya Russa and supplies the Pskov long-distance communications equipment plant (it says the plant makes secure communications equipment for the Ministry of Defense, Gazprom and RZD), and links the act to its earlier blast of two trunk gas pipelines around Saint Petersburg (claim post and video attached). Not independently verified.

ambargo.name: Drone attack on locomotive in Starodubsky district
ambargo.note: A drone is attacking a locomotive*. * The coordinates are approximate. Attribution (Nov 2026 N/A review, fifth pass): USF - InformNapalm (June 8, video attached) says operators of the 413th Raid regiment of the USF hit a locomotive that the enemy used for military cargo near Pantusov in Bryansk Oblast, about 40 km from the border, the third locomotive hit by the Raid operators recently; Zloy Odessit (June 8, photo attached) relays the regiment's own video of the drone strike on a Moscow-Simferopol locomotive near the village of Pantusov. Confidence: high.

ambargo.name: LSR partisans burn 4 relay cabinets near Sovetsky
ambargo.note: LSR partisans are burning 4 relay cabinets. Detail (Nov 2026): the LSR channel says a member of the Resistance put 4 relay cabinets out of action, cutting a rail supply route of military unit 13766 (the 255th motorized rifle regiment) and of the front, and that the repair will take time (claim post attached). Not independently verified.

ambargo.name: Explosion and fire at Arsenal plant in Saint Petersburg, 1 dead
ambargo.note: Explosion and fire on the territory of the "Arsenal" plant*. 1 dead. * Probable location of the explosion. Attribution (Nov 2026 N/A review, fifth pass): none found. Exilenova+ (June 8, photos and videos attached) says a fire broke out at the "Arsenal" plant, probably in a hangar with chemical reagents, the blast wave breaking a brick wall; Astra (June 8, video attached) likewise reports an explosion in a hangar with chemical reagents; The Moscow Times (source) later reports four dead. The sources describe an explosion and fire, not an attack, and no unit or claim was found. Stays N/A.

ambargo.name: Colonel Damir Davydov killed in car explosion in Balashikha
ambargo.note: Colonel Damir Davydov is killed as a result of a car explosion. Attribution (Oct 2026 N/A review): GUR - attributed by the site rule that targeted killings, bombings and sabotage inside the Russian Federation belong to GUR; no claim of responsibility was found.
