ambargo.name: SOF and Chernaya Iskra drone strike on Orenburg helium plant
ambargo.note: The Special Operations Forces (SOF), in cooperation with the insurgent movement in Russia "Chernaya Iskra", strike a helium plant with drones. Detail (Nov 2026): the SOF statement of June 24 (t.me/ukr_sof/2997) says SOF Deep Strike units, in interaction with the Chernaya Iskra movement, hit the Orenburg helium plant, which extracts 8.8 million cubic metres of helium a year, together with the gas processing plant overnight; the Chernaya Iskra channel (photo attached) says the helium plant goes for a long overhaul after the attack; the General Staff statement of June 24 (card attached) calls it the only helium plant in Russia, hit with the gas processing plant, over 1,200 km from the line of contact; Exilenova+ (June 24, video attached) relays the governor's report of a successful attack on the gas processing plant.

ambargo.name: Drone attack on the Bashneft-UNPZ refinery in Ufa
ambargo.note: Drones attack the "Bashneft-UNPZ" oil refinery. The ELOU-AVT-6 unit is hit. Attribution (Oct 2026 N/A review, fourth pass): SBU - on 25 Jun 2026 President Zelensky said an SBU strike hit two refineries in Ufa and the SBU named Bashneft-Novoil and Bashneft-Ufaneftekhim (Interfax-Ukraine); the SBU Alpha center carried it out. The record names Bashneft-UNPZ, so the match is by city and date, not by plant name. Confidence: low. Detail (Nov 2026): the SBU statement of June 25 (card attached) says the SBU Alpha center hit the production capacities of the Bashneft group refineries in Ufa, 1,500 km from the border, with fires at at least two separate seats and the AVT units, the "heart" of the plants, burning, and names the plants Bashneft-Novoil and Bashneft-Ufaneftekhim; Kiber Boroshno (June 25, image attached) confirms the burning of two units, ELOU-AVT-6 at Bashneft-UNPZ and an AVT unit at Ufaneftekhim; Exilenova+ (June 25, videos attached) posted the moment of the hit on the refinery and the missed air defense shot.

ambargo.name: Drone attack on the Bashneft-Ufaneftekhim refinery in Ufa
ambargo.note: Drones attack the "Bashneft-Ufaneftekhim" oil refinery. The AVT-4 unit is hit. Attribution (Oct 2026 review): SBU - SBU 40-day operation report (slovoidilo.ua, 2026-07-15). Detail (Nov 2026): the SBU statement of June 25 (card attached) says the SBU Alpha center hit the Bashneft-Ufaneftekhim and Bashneft-Novoil refineries in Ufa, 1,500 km from the border, with the AVT units burning; Kiber Boroshno (June 25, image attached) confirms the burning of the AVT unit at Ufaneftekhim; Exilenova+ (June 25, videos attached) posted the moment of the hit on the refinery and the missed air defense shot.

ambargo.name: Drone attack and fire at an oil depot in Poltavskaya
ambargo.note: Drones attack an oil depot. Fire on the territory of the enterprise. Attribution (Oct 2026 review): SBU - SBU 40-day operation report (slovoidilo.ua, 2026-07-15). Detail (Nov 2026): the SBU statement of June 25 (card attached) says SBU drones hit the Poltavskaya oil depot in Krasnodar Krai overnight, a large complex for receiving, storing and shipping diesel and petrol with 28 tanks; the General Staff statement of June 25 (card attached) records a fire on the territory; Exilenova+ (June 25, video and photo attached) says local residents reported two tanks attacked.

ambargo.name: Drone attack on a satellite communications center in Beloomut
ambargo.note: Drones attack a satellite communications center*. * The exact point of impact has not been identified. Attribution (Oct 2026 GS review): GS - announced by the General Staff as an operation of Defense Forces units; the executing unit was not named. Detail (Nov 2026): the General Staff statement of July 1 (card attached) says analysis confirms the hit of June 26 on the center near Beloomut in Moscow Oblast, called the most modernized and powerful communications node of the Russian armed forces in the central region, with the main technical building, large antennas and a tower with parabolic antennas hit, some of them destroyed; Dosye Shpiona (July 2, photos attached) says 12 strike UAVs were used against the Satellite Communications Center of the 14th Main Communications Center of the Russian General Staff. No SBU, SOF or USF statement on this target was found.

ambargo.name: Flamingo missile strike on the Titan-Barrikady plant in Volgograd
ambargo.note: FP-5 "Flamingo" missile strike on the "Titan-Barrikady" plant. Attribution (Nov 2026 review): GS - Land Forces, Missile Troops and Artillery (General Staff statement of June 27, card attached: units of Missile Troops and Artillery hit the plant). This replaces the earlier note that the executing unit was not named. Detail (Nov 2026): the General Staff statement of June 27 (card attached) says Missile Troops and Artillery units hit the Titan-Barrikady plant in Volgograd, which makes self-propelled launchers and transporter-loaders for Iskander-M, launchers for Topol-M and Yars and heavy howitzers, and its statement of June 28 (card attached) gives the results of the missile strike; Exilenova+ (June 27-30, videos attached) posted the moment of the FP-5 Flamingo strikes and a panorama of two missile hits; InformNapalm (June 30, video attached) analyses high-quality video of the Flamingo flights and arrivals.

ambargo.name: Drone attack and large fire at the Slavyansk-na-Kubani refinery
ambargo.note: Drones attack an oil refinery*. Large-scale fire on the territory of the enterprise. * The exact point of impact has not been identified. Attribution (Oct 2026 review): SBU + GUR - SBU 40-day operation report (slovoidilo.ua, 2026-07-15). Detail (Nov 2026): the SBU statement of June 28 (card attached) says the SBU Alpha center, together with the USF, GUR and other components of the Defense Forces, hit the Slavyansky refinery (Slavyansk ECO) within the 40-day operation, with fires at the tank farm, the product tank park and the primary distillation unit; the General Staff statements of June 28 and June 30 (the June 28 card attached) confirm the hit, four destroyed tanks totaling 35,000 cubic metres, nine more damaged and the oil processing unit; Exilenova+ (June 28, videos and photos attached) posted the attack and a close-range clip, and its satellite analysis of July 3 (photos attached) confirms at least 17 destroyed tanks and two AVT units hit.

ambargo.name: Atesh partisans burn a railway relay cabinet in Novomoskovsk
ambargo.note: Partisans of the "Atesh" movement burn a relay cabinet on the railway*. * Coordinates are approximate. Detail (Nov 2026): the Atesh channel says its agents hit the power distribution cabinet that fed the Azot plant in Novomoskovsk and burned a relay cabinet on the railway track, causing logistics disruption (claim post and video attached). Not independently verified.

ambargo.name: Drone attack on the Dubna space communications center
ambargo.note: Drones attack the "Dubna" space communications center (SCC). Heavy smoke on the territory of the center*. * The exact point of impact has not been identified. Attribution (Nov 2026 review): USF - the USF commander's post of June 30 (t.me/robert_magyar/2538) says the pilots of the 1st Separate Center of the USF made the second strike on the "Dubna" station overnight on June 30. This replaces the earlier GS attribution, which rested only on a statement by the President. Detail (Nov 2026): the USF commander's post of June 30 (t.me/robert_magyar/2538) says the pilots of the 1st Separate Center of the USF made a second strike on the "Dubna" station within a week; Exilenova+ (June 30, video attached) posted a video of the attack on the center, its text repeating the description of the June 22 strike; the earlier General Staff statements of June 22 and June 24 describe the first hit on the center, and no General Staff statement on this second strike was found in the posts of May 31-July 6.

ambargo.name: Fire at Tulanefteprodukt in Tula
ambargo.note: The territory of PJSC "Tulanefteprodukt" is on fire. Attribution (Nov 2026 N/A review, fifth pass): none found. Astra (July 1, photos attached) says the territory of Tulanefteprodukt, the Rosneft subsidiary that runs the Tula oil depots and filling stations, caught fire after an air-danger alert in the region, the cause unknown and the authorities silent; no unit or official claim was found in the General Staff, SBU, SOF and USF posts of July 1-Aug 3 that were checked. Stays N/A.

ambargo.name: Fire at an electrical substation in Lyubertsy, blackout
ambargo.note: An electrical substation is on fire. Part of the city is without electricity. Attribution (Nov 2026 N/A review, fifth pass): none found. Exilenova+ (July 1, videos and photos attached) says a substation caught fire in Lyubertsy near Moscow and part of the city lost power; the post names no cause; no unit or official claim was found in the General Staff, SBU, SOF and USF posts of July 1-Aug 3 that were checked. Stays N/A.

ambargo.name: Drone attack on NIIFI in Penza
ambargo.note: Drones attack JSC "NIIFI". Attribution (Oct 2026 GS review): GS - announced by the General Staff as an operation of Defense Forces units; the executing unit was not named. Detail (Nov 2026): Exilenova+ (July 1, videos attached) relayed reports from Penza of an attack and an arrival early in the morning, and its post of July 4 (photo attached) showed the aftermath; the General Staff statement of July 1 (card attached) says Defense Forces units hit the Scientific Research Institute of Physical Measurements (NIIFI), part of the Roscosmos group, with a hit and smoke recorded; the plant makes sensors for cruise and ballistic missiles (Iskander, Kalibr, Kh-101) and onboard aircraft systems.

ambargo.name: Defense Forces strike the Lukoil-NORSI refinery in Kstovo
ambargo.note: The Defense Forces strike the Lukoil-Nizhegorodnefteorgsintez (NORSI) oil refinery. The AVT-6 primary oil refining unit is burning. Attribution (Nov 2026 review): SBU + SOF + USF + GUR - the SBU statement of July 2 (card attached) says the SBU struck the refinery and the Starolikeevo pumping station in Kstovo together with SOF, USF and GUR, 850 km from the border, and the SOF statement of July 2 (card attached) says SOF Deep Strike units hit the refinery together with the USF, GUR and SBU. This replaces the earlier citation of the 40-day operation report. Detail (Nov 2026): Exilenova+ (July 2, videos attached) posted more footage of the burning refinery; InformNapalm (July 2, video and photos attached) says a strong fire was visible at the plant in the morning; Kiber Boroshno (July 2, photo in sources) says footage from the site shows the fire on AVT-6, the most powerful unit of the plant; the General Staff statement of July 2 (card attached) says the hit and fire were recorded and AVT-6 was preliminarily hit, the plant having a design capacity of about 17 million tonnes of oil a year.

ambargo.name: Drone attack on a substation in Tomarovka, residents without power
ambargo.note: Drones attack an electrical substation. Residents are without electricity supply. Attribution (Nov 2026 N/A review, fifth pass): none found. Belgorod's "Pepel" (July 2) says a drone hit a substation in the Yakovlevsky district settlement of Tomarovka and that the nearby village of Kustovoye lost power too; no unit or official claim was found in the General Staff, SBU, SOF and USF posts of July 1-Aug 3 that were checked. Stays N/A.

ambargo.name: LSR partisans set fire to an EW communications tower in Glyboka
ambargo.note: LSR partisans set fire to a communications tower with EW (electronic warfare) equipment. Detail (Nov 2026): the LSR channel (July 2, claim post attached) says its "Clean Sky" series neutralized the electronic-warfare equipment that protected an ammunition arsenal of the Russian Defense Ministry by destroying the equipment of the communications tower the EW depends on; the post gives no date beyond July 2 (claim post attached). Not independently verified.

ambargo.name: Missile strike on the Michurinskaya CHP plant substation in Belgorod
ambargo.note: Missile strike on an electrical substation on the territory of the "Michurinskaya" CHP plant. Disruptions to the electricity and water supply in the region. Attribution (Oct 2026 N/A review): GS - inferred from the weapon class (missile / HIMARS / air-launched munition is operated by the Missile Troops and Artillery, Air Force or Navy); Ukrainian media (Militarnyi) attribute the strike to the Defence Forces; no unit or official claim was found. Confidence: medium. Detail (Nov 2026): Exilenova+ (July 3, photos attached) geolocated the attack on the Michurinskaya CHP in Belgorod (50.6109N 36.5671E, camera position 50.6111N 36.5705E) and relayed residents' reports of power cuts; Belgorod's "Pepel" (July 3, photo attached) shows the substation on the territory of the GT CHP "Energo" on Michurin Street burning after the strike.

ambargo.name: Missile strike on the Yuzhnaya substation in Belgorod
ambargo.note: Missile strike on the "Yuzhnaya" electrical substation. Disruptions to the electricity and water supply in the region. Attribution (Nov 2026 N/A review, fifth pass): the GS attribution made in the Oct 2026 N/A review is withdrawn. It was inferred, with low confidence, only from the weapon class (a missile is operated by the Missile Troops and Artillery, Air Force or Navy), and no Ukrainian unit or official claim was found. The Moscow Times (July 7) and LRT (in sources) report the missile strikes on Belgorod's energy system; the same substation was hit again by drones on July 25 (a separate record). Stays N/A.

ambargo.name: Missile strike on the Frunzenskaya substation in Dragunske
ambargo.note: Missile strike on the "Frunzenskaya" electrical substation. Attribution (Nov 2026 N/A review, fifth pass): the GS attribution made in the Oct 2026 N/A review is withdrawn. It was inferred, with low confidence, only from the weapon class (a missile is operated by the Missile Troops and Artillery, Air Force or Navy), and no Ukrainian unit or official claim was found. The strike is known mainly from Russian-side reports (Novaya Gazeta Europe, July 5, in sources). Stays N/A.

ambargo.name: Drone attack and fire at an oil terminal in Saint Petersburg
ambargo.note: Drones attack an oil terminal. Fire on the territory of the enterprise. Attribution (Nov 2026 review): SOF + SBU + USF + GUR - the SOF statement of July 4 (card attached) says SOF Deep Strike units hit the Petersburg oil terminal together with the USF, GUR, SBU and other Defense Forces components, and the SBU statement of July 4 (card attached) says the SBU struck it together with SOF, USF and GUR, with at least three separate fires. Both statements claim the operation, so the existing SOF primary is kept. Detail (Nov 2026): Exilenova+ (July 4, videos and photos attached) posted the moment of the arrivals and the burning terminal; the SOF statement of July 4 (card attached) says several SOF drones reached their targets and a fire was raging on site; the General Staff statement of July 4 (card attached) records a hit and fire on the terminal, with a design throughput of 12.5 million tonnes a year, and its statement of July 11 (card attached) says two RVS-3000, four RVS-10000, one RVS-15000 and one RVS-20000 tanks, a pipe rack and other process equipment were damaged.

ambargo.name: Missile strike on the Belgorodskaya CHP plant, city blacked out
ambargo.note: Missile strike on the "Belgorodskaya" CHP plant*. Almost complete power outage in the city. No water supply. * The exact point of impact has not been identified. Attribution (Nov 2026 N/A review, fifth pass): the GS attribution made in the Oct 2026 N/A review is withdrawn. It was inferred, with low confidence, only from the weapon class (a missile is operated by the Missile Troops and Artillery, Air Force or Navy), and no Ukrainian unit or official claim was found. Charter97 (July 4) and The Moscow Times (July 7) report the missile strike and the blackout in Belgorod. Stays N/A.

ambargo.name: Missile strike on the Luch CHP plant in Belgorod
ambargo.note: Missile strike on the "Luch" CHP plant*. Almost complete power outage in the city. No water supply. * The exact point of impact has not been identified. Attribution (Nov 2026 N/A review, fifth pass): the GS attribution made in the Oct 2026 N/A review is withdrawn. It was inferred, with low confidence, only from the weapon class (a missile is operated by the Missile Troops and Artillery, Air Force or Navy), and no Ukrainian unit or official claim was found. Charter97 (July 4) and The Moscow Times (July 7) report the missile strike and the blackout in Belgorod. Stays N/A.

ambargo.name: Missile strike on the Avtoremzavod substation in Belgorod
ambargo.note: Missile strike on the "Avtoremzavod" electrical substation. Almost complete power outage in the city. No water supply. Attribution (Nov 2026 N/A review, fifth pass): the GS attribution made in the Oct 2026 N/A review is withdrawn. It was inferred, with low confidence, only from the weapon class (a missile is operated by the Missile Troops and Artillery, Air Force or Navy), and no Ukrainian unit or official claim was found. Charter97 (July 4) and The Moscow Times (July 7) report the missile strike and the blackout in Belgorod. Stays N/A.

ambargo.name: Fire at a paint and varnish warehouse in Stavropol
ambargo.note: A warehouse of paint and varnish products is on fire on the territory of the regional industrial park "SKIP Master". The fire area is 5000 sq. m. Attribution (Nov 2026 N/A review, fifth pass): none found. The regional ministry of natural resources (July 4, photo attached) says a warehouse of paint and varnish products caught fire on the SKIP Master industrial park site on Kulakov Avenue, with more than 30 people and 10 units of equipment at work and no excess of air pollutants; the post names no cause; no unit or official claim was found in the General Staff, SBU, SOF and USF posts of July 1-Aug 3 that were checked. Stays N/A.

ambargo.name: Chernaya Iskra partisans blow up a fuel tank car in Kinel
ambargo.note: Samara Oblast. "Chernaya Iskra" partisans blow up a tank car with fuel and lubricants (POL)*. * Coordinates are approximate. Detail (Nov 2026): the Chernaya Iskra channel (July 5, claim post attached) says it blew up a tank car with fuel and lubricants for the military at the Kinel junction station in Samara Oblast, its second action on this station after the earlier blast under a main-line locomotive (claim post attached). Not independently verified.

ambargo.name: Drone attack on the 26th Missile Brigade base near Luga
ambargo.note: Drones attack the permanent deployment site of the 26th Missile Brigade. At least 2 buildings are damaged. Attribution (Oct 2026 GS review): GS - announced by the General Staff as an operation of Defense Forces units; the executing unit was not named. Detail (Nov 2026): Exilenova+ (July 6, videos and photos attached) says the permanent deployment site of the 26th Missile Brigade near Luga was hit before dawn, and its post of July 7 (photo attached) gives the aftermath, noting that the damage was found only after the coordinates were checked against the video and that the brigade is one of those armed with Iskander-M; the General Staff statement of July 6 (card attached) lists the brigade's site among the targets.

ambargo.name: Drone attack on the Omsk refinery, AVT-11 unit hit
ambargo.note: Drones attack an oil refinery. The AVT-11 unit is hit. Attribution (Nov 2026 review): SOF - the General Staff statement of July 6 (card attached) says SOF units hit the Omsk refinery, the last of the 11 largest Russian gasoline producers to be struck, and the SOF statement of July 6 (card attached) says SOF Deep Strike units hit the primary unit ELOU-AVT-11, the plant's first strike and the deepest of the full-scale war, up to 3,000 km. Detail (Nov 2026): Kiber Boroshno and Dnipro Osint (July 6-7, photos attached) say modernized FP-1 drones hit the process columns of the ELOU-AVT-11 unit (8.4 million tonnes a year, coordinates 55.0696N 73.2094E), over 2,500 km from the border; Exilenova+ (July 6, videos attached) shows kilometre-long smoke columns over the city and its July 7 satellite analysis (photo attached) finds at least four drone hits on AVT-11 and damaged pipe racks but none on AVT-10.
ambargo.weapon: FP-1 (claim by Kiber Boroshno / Dnipro Osint)

ambargo.name: Drone attack and fire at the Yaroslavl oil refinery
ambargo.note: Drones attack an oil refinery. Fire on the territory of the enterprise*. * The exact point of impact has not been identified. Attribution (Nov 2026 review): SBU - the SBU statement of July 6 (card attached) says the SBU, together with other Defense Forces components, hit the Yaroslavl refinery and the Yaroslavl pumping station, and its weekly report of July 7 puts the target more than 700 km from the border. Detail (Nov 2026): Exilenova+ (July 6, video and photo attached) relayed local reports of a successful attack on the refinery; Astra (July 6, photo attached) quotes the governor that more than 70 drones were shot down on approach and two people were hurt by fragments, with no word on industrial damage, while Astra's own analysis showed smoke above the Slavneft-YANOS site; the General Staff statement of July 6 (card attached) says Defense Forces units hit the refinery again, with explosions and smoke recorded, and its statement of July 11 (card attached) says a hit on the AVT-6 unit and damage to the pipelines of AVT-1 and AVT-3 were recorded.

ambargo.name: Drone attack on NOVATEK in Ust-Luga
ambargo.note: Drones attack PJSC "NOVATEK". Attribution (Oct 2026 GS review): GS - announced by the General Staff as an operation of Defense Forces units; the executing unit was not named. Detail (Nov 2026): Exilenova+ (July 6, video and photo attached) relayed the governor's report of an attack on the Ust-Luga port and the Luga range; the General Staff statement of July 6 (card attached) lists the NOVATEK-Ust-Luga refinery (Slobodka) among the targets hit. The General Staff's statements of July 10 and July 12 describe a repeat strike on the complex and confirmed damage to a processing unit; that second strike is not in the tab as a separate record.

ambargo.name: Missile strike on the trunk gas pipeline department in Belgorod
ambargo.note: Missile strike on the linear production department of trunk gas pipelines (LVUMG). Fire on the territory of the enterprise. Attribution (Nov 2026 N/A review, fifth pass): the GS attribution made in the Oct 2026 N/A review is withdrawn. It was inferred, with low confidence, only from the weapon class (a missile is operated by the Missile Troops and Artillery, Air Force or Navy), and no Ukrainian unit or official claim was found. Militarnyi and The Public (July 7, in sources) say a fire broke out at a Gazprom gas-infrastructure facility after a night missile strike. Stays N/A.

ambargo.name: Drone attack and fire at the oil refinery in Starki
ambargo.note: Drones attack an oil refinery. Fire on the territory of the enterprise. Detail (Nov 2026): Exilenova+ (July 7, photo attached) relays the governor's confirmation of a repeat attack on the Pervyi Zavod mini-refinery in Kaluga Oblast, first hit two days earlier; the SBU statement of July 6 (t.me/SBUkr/18016, in sources) says SBU drones also worked on the "Pervyi Zavod" refinery in Kaluga Oblast, and its weekly reports of July 7 and July 13 list the plant among SBU drone targets, but they do not separate the first and the second strike, so the SBU attribution rests on that listing.

ambargo.name: Drone attack on the Krasnodarskaya compressor station in Severskiy
ambargo.note: Drones attack the "Krasnodarskaya" compressor station. The gas cooling unit is damaged. Attribution (Nov 2026 N/A review, fifth pass): none found. Dnipro Osint (July 9, photo attached) says SBU drones damaged the gas cooling unit of the "Krasnodarskaya" compressor station of the Blue Stream pipeline (44.7571N 38.7604E), with repair vehicles and fire aftermath visible; Exilenova+ (July 7, videos attached) and Astra (July 7, video and photos attached, filmed 2.5 km away in the village of Smolenskaya) show the attack, and the regional headquarters said drone debris fell and caused a local fire at one enterprise. The SBU did not list the strike in its statements and weekly reports of July 7-27, so one channel's mention of SBU drones is not enough for an attribution. Stays N/A.

ambargo.name: Missile strike and fire at Belgorod airport
ambargo.note: Missile strike on the airport*. Fire on the territory of the facility. * The exact point of impact has not been identified. Attribution (Oct 2026 GS review): GS - announced by the General Staff as an operation of Defense Forces units; the executing unit was not named. The match between the statement and this exact target is approximate. Detail (Nov 2026): Exilenova+ (July 6-7, videos attached) says a missile strike hit Belgorod's energy facilities, preliminarily the CHP; Hromadske (in sources) says the General Staff confirmed the strike on Belgorod in which an oil depot was attacked, and the General Staff statement of July 7 lists the fuel depot of the Belgorod airfield among its targets, which is why the record keeps the GS attribution with an approximate match.

ambargo.name: Drone attack on the Borisoglebsk airbase, fuel tank farm destroyed
ambargo.note: Drones attack the airbase. The fuel and lubricants tank farm is destroyed. Attribution (Oct 2026 GS review): GS - announced by the General Staff as an operation of Defense Forces units; the executing unit was not named. Detail (Nov 2026): Exilenova+ (July 7, video and photo attached) gives the base coordinates (51.3617N 42.1900E) and says Defense Forces strike UAVs probably hit the airfield where Su-34, Su-35 and Su-30SM aircraft are based; Astra (July 7, video and photos attached) geolocated eyewitness footage of the burning airfield; AviVector (July 10, photo attached) says the fuel and lubricants tank farm built in winter 2023 was destroyed; the General Staff statement of July 8 (card attached) records the hit, and its statement of July 11 (card attached) says 28 tanks with aviation kerosene, 1,600 cubic metres in all, caught fire.

ambargo.name: Drone attack on the TAIF-NK refinery in Nizhnekamsk
ambargo.note: Drones attack the "TAIF-NK" oil refinery. Fire on the territory of the enterprise. Attribution (Nov 2026 review): SOF - the SOF statement of July 8 (card attached) says SOF Deep Strike units hit two Nizhnekamsk refineries, TANECO and TAIF-NK, several SOF drones reaching their targets. Detail (Nov 2026): Exilenova+ (July 8, videos and photos attached) posted the attack on Nizhnekamsk and the morning view; its analysis of July 8 (photo attached) records a large fire at the ELOU-AVT-7 unit (7.3 million tonnes a year, 55.6049N 51.9557E) and burning technological racks of the refinery and of the neighbouring ethylene plant, calling it the most effective of the night's hits; the General Staff statement of July 11 (card attached) says the delayed coking unit of TAIF-NK caught fire and cable racks, pipelines and buildings were damaged.

ambargo.name: Drone attack on the TANECO refinery in Nizhnekamsk
ambargo.note: Drones attack the "TANECO" oil refinery*. Fire on the territory of the enterprise. * The exact point of impact has not been identified. Attribution (Nov 2026 review): SOF - the SOF statement of July 8 (card attached) says SOF Deep Strike units hit two Nizhnekamsk refineries, TANECO and TAIF-NK, several SOF drones reaching their targets. Detail (Nov 2026): Exilenova+ (July 8, videos and photos attached) posted the attack on Nizhnekamsk and the morning view; the SOF statement of July 8 (card attached) says TANECO, a plant with a refining depth of up to 99 percent, was burning after several SOF drones reached their targets. The exact point of impact at TANECO is not shown in the footage.

ambargo.name: Drone attack on the Saratov refinery, isomerization unit hit
ambargo.note: Drones attack an oil refinery. An isomerization unit and two tanks are hit. Attribution (Oct 2026 GS review): GS - announced by the General Staff as an operation of Defense Forces units; the executing unit was not named. Detail (Nov 2026): Exilenova+ (July 8, videos and photos attached) posted the attack and its aftermath, and its analysis of July 8 (photo attached) records a hit and fire on the pentane-hexane isomerization unit and burning communications near ELOU-AVT-6 and at the tank farm; Dnipro Osint (July 10, satellite image attached) confirms the isomerization unit and two tanks hit, one tank fully destroyed; the General Staff statement of July 8 (card attached) records explosions and a fire, the plant having a design capacity of about 7 million tonnes a year, and its statement of July 11 (card attached) adds the BDA.

ambargo.name: Drone attack on the Cherkassy linear production dispatch station
ambargo.note: Drones attack the linear production dispatch station (LPDS) "Cherkassy". Attribution (Nov 2026 review): SBU - the SBU statement of July 8 (card attached) says SBU drones hit the Cherkassy LPDS of the Transneft-Ural system, and its weekly report of July 13 repeats it. Detail (Nov 2026): Exilenova+ (July 8, photo attached) says the Cherkassy-PP station's tank farm, about 400,000 cubic metres split between gasoline and diesel, burned on a large scale (54.9070N 56.1678E) and that the station is a key node of the products pipeline that links the Ufa refineries with the Omsk, Salavat, Perm and Tyumen plants; the SBU statement of July 8 (card attached) says at least eight SBU drones hit the station, 1,500 km from the border, with a fire at the tank farm and production facilities.
ambargo.weapon: Strike UAVs (at least 8; model not stated)

ambargo.name: LSR partisans set fire to a transformer at a substation in Astrakhan
ambargo.note: LSR partisans set fire to a transformer on the territory of an electrical substation. Detail (Nov 2026): the LSR channel (July 8, claim post attached) says its "Rubilnik" series put the transformer of a substation in the northern industrial zone of Astrakhan out of action (a cost of at least 500,000 dollars), which stopped the Astrakhan Fiberglass plant that makes composite parts for drones and cut power to the territory of a former machine-tool plant that the post says serves as a drone assembly and storage shop (claim post attached). Not independently verified.

ambargo.name: Drone attack on the Tvernefteprodukt oil depot in Tver
ambargo.note: Drones attack the "Tvernefteprodukt" oil depot. Fire on the territory of the enterprise. Attribution (Nov 2026 review): SBU - the SBU statement of July 9 (card attached) says the SBU hit the Chervona Zorya oil depot in Tver Oblast overnight, 520 km from the border, with drone hits and a fire; the match is by date and region. Detail (Nov 2026): Exilenova+ (July 9, videos and photos attached) says the Tvernefteprodukt depot in Tver was attacked and relays local footage, and its July 17 post (photo attached) shows the aftermath ("not much, a lot of work left"); Astra (July 9, videos attached) says the Tver depot was attacked and burning.

ambargo.name: Drone attack and fire at the Lukoil-Yugnefteprodukt depot in Vyazniki
ambargo.note: Drones attack the "Lukoil-Yugnefteprodukt" oil depot. Fire on the territory of the enterprise. Attribution (Nov 2026 review): SBU - the SBU statement of July 9 (card attached) says the SBU hit the Stavropolskaya oil depot in Stavropol Krai overnight, more than 500 km from the border, with a large fire that was spreading quickly; the match is by date and region. Detail (Nov 2026): Exilenova+ (July 9, videos attached) says the Lukoil-Yugnefteprodukt depot in Mikhailovsk, Stavropol Krai, was attacked, and its July 10 satellite image (photo attached) shows the aftermath; Militarnyi and Slovo i Dilo (July 9, in sources) report burning depots in Tver and Stavropol Krai.

ambargo.name: Drone attack and fire at an oil refinery in Krasnodar Krai
ambargo.note: Drones attack an oil refinery*. Fire on the territory of the enterprise. * The exact point of impact has not been identified. Attribution (Nov 2026 review): GUR + USF - the GUR post of July 10 (photo attached) says GUR specialists hit the Ilsky refinery in a deepstrike operation joint with the USF, the Border Guard Service and other Defense Forces components. This replaces the earlier USF primary with GUR as a co-unit. Detail (Nov 2026): Exilenova+ (July 10-11, videos and photos attached) posted the attack and the next-day footage, and its analysis of July 10 says the burning zone surrounds ELOU-AVT-6 (3.6 million tonnes a year, 56 percent of the plant's capacity), the material being too thin to fix the exact hit; the General Staff statement of July 10 (card attached) records explosions and a fire and calls it a repeat strike, and its statement of July 11 (card attached) says the AT-5 and AT-6 units caught fire and pipelines were damaged.

ambargo.name: Drone attack on the Kurgannefteprodukt oil terminal in Taganrog
ambargo.note: Drones attack the oil terminal of LLC "Kurgannefteprodukt". Fire on the territory of the enterprise. Attribution (Oct 2026 GS review): GS - announced by the General Staff as an operation of Defense Forces units; the executing unit was not named. Detail (Nov 2026): Exilenova+ (July 10, videos attached) relayed local reports of fire in the port area of Taganrog after an attack that lasted all night, and its analysis puts the Kurgannefteprodukt terminal at 47.2020N 38.9465E; Astra (July 10, photos attached) says a large fire burned after the night attack; the General Staff statement of July 10 (card attached) records a fire at the terminal.

ambargo.name: Drone attack on the Port oil depot in Azov
ambargo.note: Drones attack the "Port" oil depot. Attribution (Oct 2026 GS review): GS - announced by the General Staff as an operation of Defense Forces units; the executing unit was not named. The match between the statement and this exact target is approximate. Detail (Nov 2026): Exilenova+ (July 10, videos attached) says all five Azov oil depots caught fire, among them the Port depot (Decal Azov) at 47.1112N 39.3821E, directly in the port, and its morning HD video shows the protective nets did not help; the General Staff statement of July 10 (card attached) records a fire at the Azovnefteprodukt depot in Azov.

ambargo.name: Drone attack on DonTerminal oil depot No. 1 in Azov
ambargo.note: Drones attack oil depot No. 1 of LLC "DonTerminal". Attribution (Oct 2026 GS review): GS - announced by the General Staff as an operation of Defense Forces units; the executing unit was not named. The match between the statement and this exact target is approximate. Detail (Nov 2026): Exilenova+ (July 10, videos attached) says all five Azov oil depots caught fire, among them depot No. 1 of DonTerminal (47.0984N 39.3791E), and its morning HD video shows the protective nets did not help; the General Staff statement of July 10 (card attached) records a fire at the Azovnefteprodukt depot in Azov.

ambargo.name: Drone attack on oil depot No. 2 at Azov railway station
ambargo.note: Drones attack oil depot No. 2 of the "Azov" railway station. Attribution (Oct 2026 GS review): GS - announced by the General Staff as an operation of Defense Forces units; the executing unit was not named. The match between the statement and this exact target is approximate. Detail (Nov 2026): Exilenova+ (July 10, videos attached) says all five Azov oil depots caught fire, among them depot No. 2 of the Azov railway station (47.0965N 39.4262E); the General Staff statement of July 10 (card attached) records a fire at the Azovnefteprodukt depot in Azov.

ambargo.name: Fire at the Kapotnya refinery in Moscow
ambargo.note: Moscow. Fire on the territory of the "Kapotnya" oil refinery. Attribution (Nov 2026 N/A review, fifth pass): none found. Exilenova+ (July 10, video and photos attached) relayed a reported fire near the Kapotnya refinery in Moscow and said it was clarifying what was burning; no unit or official claim was found in the General Staff, SBU, SOF and USF posts of July 1-Aug 3 that were checked. Stays N/A.

ambargo.name: Drone attack on the Syzran refinery, AVT-5 and AVT-6 units hit
ambargo.note: Drones attack an oil refinery. The AVT-5 and AVT-6 units are hit. Attribution (Oct 2026 review): USF + GUR - USF statement (tsn.ua, 2026-07-12). Detail (Nov 2026): Exilenova+ (July 12, photos attached) says AVT-5 of the Syzran refinery was wrecked, with several fire points and burnt technical racks; Kiber Boroshno (July 12, video and photos attached) says FP-1 drones hit the refinery in daytime, 900 km from the border; the General Staff statement of July 12 (card attached) records explosions and a fire, and its statement of July 13 (card attached) confirms damage to both primary units, AVT-5 and AVT-6.

ambargo.name: Atesh partisans set fire to an EW communications tower in Fokino
ambargo.note: Partisans of the "Atesh" movement set fire to a communications tower with EW antennas*. * Probable location of the sabotage. Detail (Nov 2026): the Atesh channel (July 12, claim post, videos and photos attached) says its agents burned towers carrying electronic-warfare complexes in Fokino and Karachev in Bryansk Oblast, opening a corridor for drones; the Fokino site is the location of this record (claim post attached). Not independently verified.

ambargo.name: Drone attack on the Lukoil-Yugnefteprodukt oil depot in Vyazniki
ambargo.note: Drones attack the "Lukoil-Yugnefteprodukt" oil depot. Fire on the territory of the enterprise. Attribution (Nov 2026 review): SBU - the SBU statement of July 13 (card attached) lists the tank farm of the oil depot in Vyazniki, Stavropol Krai (600 km), among the targets its drones hit overnight, and its weekly report of July 20 repeats it. This replaces the earlier citation of the 40-day operation report. Detail (Nov 2026): 24tv, Slovo i Dilo and Militarnyi (July 13, in sources) report the second attack in two weeks on the Mikhailovsk depot.

ambargo.name: Fire at the tank farm of the Kavkaz port
ambargo.note: Fire on the territory of the tank farm of the port "Kavkaz"*. * Coordinates are approximate. Attribution (Nov 2026 review): SBU - the SBU statement of July 13 (card attached) says SBU drones hit three tanks of the oil-product transshipment complex in the Kavkaz port, together with the ferries "Lavrentiy" and "Panagia", and its weekly report of July 20 repeats it. This replaces the earlier citation of the 40-day operation report. Detail (Nov 2026): Falconins (July 13, photo attached) gives the coordinates of the burning tank farm of the Kavkaz port (45.3388N 36.6776E) and of the railway station area.

ambargo.name: Fire near the Kavkaz railway station in Port Kavkaz
ambargo.note: Fire in the area of the "Kavkaz" railway station*. * Coordinates are approximate. Attribution (Nov 2026 review): SBU - the SBU statement of July 13 (card attached) says SBU drones hit a rail depot with tank cars at the Kavkaz freight station, and its weekly report of July 20 repeats it. Detail (Nov 2026): Falconins (July 13, photo attached) gives the coordinates of the burning railway station area (45.3471N 36.6887E) and of the tank farm nearby.

ambargo.name: Border guard ship Izumrud destroyed in Gelendzhik
ambargo.note: The border guard ship "Izumrud" is destroyed. Attribution (Oct 2026 GS review): GS - Navy (Navy statement, July 2026; Sargan-3000 unmanned system). Detail (Nov 2026): Exilenova+ (July 14, videos and photos attached) relays the Navy statement that the second-rank border guard ship "Izumrud" was sunk by the Sargan-3000 uncrewed system near Novorossiysk with dead and wounded among the crew, the ship that took part in the Kerch Strait incident of Nov 25, 2018, and shows a satellite image of the destroyed ship at the quay; local reports of explosions and a strong fire in Gelendzhik, near the airfield, came earlier that night; Falconins (Aug 9, photos attached) geolocates the wreck at 44.5646N 37.9935E together with a destroyed EW complex and an S-400 launcher.

ambargo.name: Fire at the military institute of material support in Volsk
ambargo.note: Fire on the territory of the military institute of material support (VVIMZ). Attribution (Nov 2026 N/A review, fifth pass): none found. Exilenova+ (July 14, videos attached) says a building of the Military Institute of Material Support in Volsk, Saratov Oblast, the military rear department, was on fire and its roof partly collapsed; the post names no cause; no unit or official claim was found in the General Staff, SBU, SOF and USF posts of July 1-Aug 3 that were checked. Stays N/A.

ambargo.name: Drone attack and fire at the Afipsky oil refinery
ambargo.note: Drones attack an oil refinery*. Fire on the territory of the enterprise. * The exact point of impact has not been identified. Detail (Nov 2026): Astra (July 14, photo attached) says a fire started to the side of the refinery's tank farm and that the exact point cannot be seen in the footage, and the Kuban operational headquarters (July 14, Astra) confirmed a fire at the refinery after a drone attack; the General Staff statement of July 14 (card attached) says Defense Forces hit the Afipsky refinery again with a fire recorded, and Zelensky confirmed the hit the same day (Astra, July 14). None of the July statements checked names units for this strike, so the existing USF primary with SBU and GUR as co-units stays the analyst's own entry.

ambargo.name: SOF and Chernaya Iskra drone attack on the Salavat refinery
ambargo.note: The Special Operations Forces (SOF), in cooperation with the insurgent movement in Russia "Chernaya Iskra", attack an oil refinery with drones. The AVT-6 and AVT-4 units are hit. Detail (Nov 2026): the SOF statement of July 14 (card attached) says SOF Deep Strike units hit Gazprom Neftekhim Salavat in cooperation with the underground insurgent movement Chernaya Iskra, the last big gasoline producer not struck in 2026, with the critical AVT-6 primary unit hit, about 1,500 km from the border; the Chernaya Iskra channel (July 14, video attached) says it and SOF attacked the complex, the fifth refinery hit with its participation; Kiber Boroshno (July 14, photos attached) says both primary units, AVT-6 (6 million tonnes a year) and AVT-4 (4 million tonnes a year), were hit, 100 percent of the plant's primary capacity; Exilenova+ (July 14, videos and photo attached; July 16 satellite photo) and Militarnyi (July 14, photo attached) posted the attack and the aftermath; the General Staff statement of July 14 (card attached) records the hit and fire.

ambargo.name: Drone attack on the tank farm of the Slavneft-YANOS refinery
ambargo.note: Drones attack the tank farm on the territory of "Slavneft-YANOS". Attribution (Oct 2026 GS review): GS - General Staff statement of 17 Jul 2026: Slavneft-YANOS refinery hit on 16 Jul by Defense Forces units; executing unit not named. Detail (Nov 2026): Astra (July 16, photos attached) says the refinery's tank farm, a storage complex of over 620,000 cubic metres, was burning after the attack, with the governor's statement quoted; the General Staff statement of July 17 (card attached) says the Slavneft-YANOS refinery was hit on July 16.

ambargo.name: Drone strike on a Tu-95 bomber at the Engels military airfield
ambargo.note: Drones hit a Tu-95 strategic bomber* at a military airfield. * The exact point of impact has not been identified. Attribution (Nov 2026 review): SBU - the SBU statement of July 17 (card attached) says SBU long-range drones flew about 800 km and destroyed a Tu-95 strategic bomber at the Engels airfield, its tail section torn off, and the weekly report of July 20 repeats it. Detail (Nov 2026): Radio Svoboda's "Skhemy" (July 19, photo attached) published a Planet Labs image of July 19 that shows the bomber's tail torn off; the plane is one of those regularly used for Kh-101 strikes on Ukraine.

ambargo.name: Teenager sets fire to a gas station in Saint Petersburg
ambargo.note: A 16-year-old teenager sets fire to a gas station. Detained. Attribution (Nov 2026 N/A review, fifth pass): none found. Astra (July 17, videos attached), citing Fontanka, says a 16-year-old set fire to a gas station on Nepokorennykh Avenue in Saint Petersburg and was detained; the account says he was lured online, then threatened by people who called themselves "Ukrainian military employees" and pushed into the arson; that claim is unverified and no Ukrainian unit statement was found. Stays N/A.

ambargo.name: Two fuel trucks and a car burn in Bronnitsy, probable sabotage
ambargo.note: 2 fuel trucks and a car are on fire. The fire area is 5000 sq. m. Probably sabotage. Attribution (Nov 2026 N/A review, fifth pass): none found. REN TV (July 17, video and photo attached) says two fuel trucks burned in an industrial zone of Bronnitsy and the fire spread to parked GAZelles over 5,000 sq m; the "Russian Partisans" channel (July 17, videos and photo attached) claims it burned the two fuel trucks as part of a campaign to worsen the fuel crisis, and no statement ties the claim to a Ukrainian unit. Stays N/A.

ambargo.name: Drone attack and fire at an oil depot in Noginsk
ambargo.note: Drones attack an oil depot. Fire on the territory of the enterprise. Attribution (Oct 2026 GS review): GS - announced by the General Staff as an operation of Defense Forces units; the executing unit was not named. Detail (Nov 2026): Exilenova+ (July 18, videos attached) first said something was burning very hard, "maybe an oil depot", and its July 19 reconnaissance post (videos attached) says most of the tanks of the Noginsk depot burned out but not all; the General Staff statement of July 18 (card attached) says the Nafto-Servis depot in Noginsk, which supplies fuel for the armed forces, was hit with a fire on site.

ambargo.name: Drone attack on the Wildberries logistics complex in Elektrostal
ambargo.note: Drones attack the Wildberries logistics complex. Large-scale fire on the territory of the enterprise. Attribution (Oct 2026 review): USF - USF Telegram statement (militarnyi, 2026-07-18). Detail (Nov 2026): Exilenova+ (July 18, videos and photo attached) says the Wildberries logistics hub in Elektrostal was preliminarily attacked, with the first videos posted within minutes of the strike; Dnipro Osint (July 23, satellite image attached) shows the destroyed warehouses at 55.7462N 38.4182E; Kiber Boroshno's BDA of July 30 (in sources) calls it the company's largest logistics center, about 359,500 sq m, with a pyrocumulus cloud over the fire; the USF commander's post of July 25 (t.me/robert_magyar/2654) lists Elektrostal first among the "wild berry" hubs.

ambargo.name: Drone attack on the Wildberries logistics complex in Kotovsk
ambargo.note: Drones attack the Wildberries logistics complex. Large-scale fire on the territory of the enterprise. Attribution (Oct 2026 review): USF - USF Telegram statement (militarnyi, 2026-07-18). Detail (Nov 2026): Exilenova+ (July 17-18, videos attached) says a Wildberries warehouse in Kotovsk, Tambov Oblast, burned after explosions with an evacuation, and a second post says it is highly probable that Russian air defense hit the warehouse and set it on fire; Kiber Boroshno's BDA of July 30 (in sources) counts Kotovsk (a facility opened in May 2025, 142,000 sq m) among the hits with limited effect, the fire less intense than at Elektrostal.

ambargo.name: Chernaya Iskra partisans destroy a rail welding train in Ramenskoye
ambargo.note: Partisans of "Chernaya Iskra" destroy a rail welding train at the "Ramenskoye" depot. Detail (Nov 2026): the Chernaya Iskra channel (July 18, claim post attached) says it destroyed a rare self-propelled rail-welding train at the Ramenskoye depot, which serves the Zhukovsky airfield, the main base of the Gromov Flight Research Institute; the post gives no method (claim post attached). Not independently verified.

ambargo.name: Drone attack and large fire at the Lukoil-Yugnefteprodukt depot, emergency declared
ambargo.note: Drones attack an oil depot. Large-scale fire on the territory of the enterprise. A local-level emergency regime is in effect. Attribution (Nov 2026 review): SBU - the SBU statement of July 19 (card attached) says SBU drones hit three oil depots in Stavropol Krai, about 600 km from the border, with large fires and tank explosions. Detail (Nov 2026): Exilenova+ (July 18-19, videos and photos attached) says the oil depot in Mikhailovsk was attacked for the third time in a couple of weeks and shows numerous seats of fire after the attack, and Astra (July 19, videos and photo attached) shows a column of smoke over Stavropol and the governor's local emergency regime; Astra's analysis says three oil depots may be burning in Stavropol and its surroundings.

ambargo.name: Drone attack on oil tankers at the CPC terminal in Novorossiysk
ambargo.note: Drones attack the oil tankers "ASIA" and "NISSOS IOS" at the CPC marine terminal*. * Coordinates are approximate. Attribution (Nov 2026 N/A review, fifth pass): none found. The Caspian Pipeline Consortium (Astra, July 19, photo attached) says the tankers "ASIA" and "NISSOS IOS", loading Kazakh oil at single-point moorings SPM-1 and SPM-3, were hit by UAVs, a fire on "ASIA" was put out, loading was stopped, nobody was hurt, there was no spill and both ships stayed afloat. The General Staff statement of July 19 reports two tankers hit in the Black Sea without naming them and says they carry Russian oil and fuel for the army, which does not fit the CPC cargo, so the two are not matched; no unit or official claim was found in the General Staff, SBU, SOF and USF posts of July 1-Aug 3 that were checked. Stays N/A.

ambargo.name: Drone attack on a substation in Golovchino, several settlements without power
ambargo.note: Drones attack an electrical substation. Several settlements are without electricity. There is no video or photo of the impact. Attribution (Nov 2026 N/A review, fifth pass): none found. Belgorod's "Pepel" (July 19) says an emergency power cut hit the Graivoron district after a drone strike on a substation in Golovchino, with no light in Golovchino and the hamlet of Masychevo, and no video or photo of the hit; no unit or official claim was found in the General Staff, SBU, SOF and USF posts of July 1-Aug 3 that were checked. Stays N/A.

ambargo.name: Drone attack and fire at an oil depot in Podolsk
ambargo.note: Drones attack an oil depot. Fire on the territory of the enterprise. Attribution (Nov 2026 N/A review, fifth pass): none found. Kiber Boroshno (July 20, photo attached) geolocated the hit on the oil depot in Lvovsky at 55.3363N 37.5198E, together with the Wildberries hub in Koledino and the Yuzhnye Vrata park; Exilenova+ (July 20, videos and photo attached) says the depot kept burning and that repairing hit tanks usually means months or years; no unit or official claim was found in the General Staff, SBU, SOF and USF posts of July 1-Aug 3 that were checked. Stays N/A.

ambargo.name: Drone attack on a Gazprom gas station in Belomestnoye
ambargo.note: Drones attack a "Gazprom" gas station. The fueling equipment is damaged. Attribution (Nov 2026 N/A review, fifth pass): none found. Belgorod's "Pepel" (July 20) says another drone hit the Gazprom filling station by the Belgorod bypass in Belomestnoye, with smoke over the station and a truck burning; iStories (July 23, in sources) counts about a quarter of the gas stations of Belgorod and its suburbs hit within five days; no unit or official claim was found in the General Staff, SBU, SOF and USF posts of July 1-Aug 3 that were checked. Stays N/A.

ambargo.name: Drone attack on the Wildberries logistics complex in Koledino
ambargo.note: Drones attack the Wildberries logistics complex. Large-scale fire on the territory of the enterprise. Attribution (Oct 2026 N/A review): USF - falls within the Wildberries hub campaign (15 hubs in 18 days) that the USF commander (Madyar) reported on 4 Aug 2026; this hub is not named individually. Fire Point announced FP-1 use for some of the hubs. Confidence: low. Detail (Nov 2026): Exilenova+, Astra and Dnipro Osint (July 20, videos and photos attached) show the drones and the moment of the attack and place the hit on the Wildberries hub at 55.3864N 37.5862E, and Kiber Boroshno (July 20, photo attached) calls it the company's largest sorting centre; Kiber Boroshno's BDA of July 30 (in sources) adds that air defense diverted the drones, the hit fell on an adjacent warehouse of a third-party logistics operator and the main hub (about 225,000 sq m) kept working. Koledino, Voronezh, Tver and Perm do not appear in the USF commander's posts of July 18-Aug 2 that were checked, so the USF attribution here rests on the analyst's Wildberries rule alone.

ambargo.name: Drone attack on the Yuzhnye Vrata industrial park in Domodedovo
ambargo.note: Drones attack the "Yuzhnye Vrata" industrial park. Attribution (Nov 2026 N/A review, fifth pass): none found. Kiber Boroshno (July 20, photo attached) says drones hit the warehouses of the "Yuzhnye Vrata" logistics park near Belye Stolby (55.3316N 37.8210E), a large fire started and some warehouses were destroyed; Exilenova+ (July 20, videos and photo attached) shows three fire points, and Astra (July 20, videos attached) quotes the Domodedovo authorities confirming fires after a drone attack on the industrial complex. The park is not a Wildberries hub, so the Wildberries rule does not apply; no unit or official claim was found in the General Staff, SBU, SOF and USF posts of July 1-Aug 3 that were checked. Stays N/A.

ambargo.name: Drone attack on the Grivno industrial park
ambargo.note: Drones attack the "Grivno" industrial park. Attribution (Nov 2026 N/A review, fifth pass): none found. Exilenova+ (July 20, video and photo attached) says the Grivno industrial park in Motovilovo was attacked the same night as the Yuzhnye Vrata park in Domodedovo, the Wildberries hub near Podolsk and the Lvovsky oil depot; Militarnyi (in sources) reports an oil depot and four logistics warehouses within 50 km of Moscow hit that night; no unit or official claim was found in the General Staff, SBU, SOF and USF posts of July 1-Aug 3 that were checked. Stays N/A.

ambargo.name: Drone strike on a MiG-29 fighter in Khalino
ambargo.note: Drones hit a MiG-29 fighter. Attribution (Oct 2026 GS review): GS - 15th Separate Artillery Reconnaissance Brigade "Chornyi Lis" (General Staff announcement as reported by Kyiv Post / Militarnyi, 21 Jul 2026). Detail (Nov 2026): the General Staff post of July 21 (video attached, also relayed by Exilenova+) says the 15th Separate Artillery Reconnaissance Brigade "Chornyi Lis" carried out an operation at the Khalino airfield in Kursk Oblast and hit a MiG-29 fighter and a Pantsir-S1 system, adding "to be continued"; the post does not say which of the two is shown in the video.

ambargo.name: Drone strike on a Pantsir-S1 air defense system in Khalino
ambargo.note: Drones hit a "Pantsir-S1" anti-aircraft missile and gun system*. * The exact point of impact has not been identified. Attribution (Oct 2026 GS review): GS - 15th Separate Artillery Reconnaissance Brigade "Chornyi Lis" (General Staff announcement as reported by Kyiv Post / Militarnyi, 21 Jul 2026). Detail (Nov 2026): the General Staff post of July 21 (video attached) says the 15th Separate Artillery Reconnaissance Brigade "Chornyi Lis" carried out an operation at the Khalino airfield in Kursk Oblast and hit a MiG-29 fighter and a Pantsir-S1 system, adding "to be continued"; the exact point of impact on the Pantsir-S1 was not identified.

ambargo.name: Drone attack on a Lukoil gas station in Belgorod
ambargo.note: Drones attack a "Lukoil" gas station. The fueling equipment is damaged. Attribution (Nov 2026 N/A review, fifth pass): none found. Belgorod's "Pepel" (July 21, photo attached) says a drone hit the Lukoil filling station on Volchanskaya Street and a car and the fueling equipment caught fire; iStories (July 23, in sources) counts about a quarter of the gas stations of Belgorod and its suburbs hit within five days; no unit or official claim was found in the General Staff, SBU, SOF and USF posts of July 1-Aug 3 that were checked. Stays N/A.

ambargo.name: Drone attack on a second Lukoil gas station in Belgorod
ambargo.note: Drones attack a "Lukoil" gas station. The fueling equipment is damaged. Attribution (Nov 2026 N/A review, fifth pass): none found. Belgorod's "Pepel" (post of July 23, photo attached) says a drone hit the Lukoil filling station in Vodstroy and black smoke rose over it. The post is dated two days after the record date of July 21, which comes from the original entry and could not be confirmed; no unit or official claim was found in the General Staff, SBU, SOF and USF posts of July 1-Aug 3 that were checked. Stays N/A.

ambargo.name: Drone attack on a Rosneft gas station in Valuyki
ambargo.note: Drones attack a "Rosneft" gas station. After the strike, the gas station stopped operating. Attribution (Nov 2026 N/A review, fifth pass): none found. Belgorod's "Pepel" (July 21, video attached) says the commercial object in Valuyki hit by a drone is a filling station; no unit or official claim was found in the General Staff, SBU, SOF and USF posts of July 1-Aug 3 that were checked. Stays N/A.

ambargo.name: Fire at the Ladoga industrial park in Vsevolozhsk
ambargo.note: The "Ladoga" industrial park is on fire. The fire area is 5900 sq. m. Attribution (Nov 2026 N/A review, fifth pass): none found. Astra (July 20, videos attached) quotes the Emergencies Ministry: a warehouse and production building at 117 Vsevolozhsky Avenue in the "Ladoga" industrial park, which houses Terra-plast, Mixplast and a radiation technologies centre, is burning over 5,900 sq m and the cause is being established; Exilenova+ (July 20, videos and photo attached) describes the fire as having started by itself; no unit or official claim was found in the General Staff, SBU, SOF and USF posts of July 1-Aug 3 that were checked. Stays N/A.

ambargo.name: Drone attack on the Armavir dispatch station, fuel tank damaged
ambargo.note: Drones attack the linear production dispatch station (LPDS) "Armavir". A fuel tank is damaged. Attribution (Nov 2026 N/A review, fifth pass): none found. Exilenova+ (July 22, videos and photos attached) and Radio Svoboda (July 22, video attached) show the attack on the oil depot in Armavir and the fire after explosions; Astra (July 22, in sources) quotes the Kuban operational headquarters on a fire at one of the enterprises of Armavir after a drone attack; no unit or official claim was found in the General Staff, SBU, SOF and USF posts of July 1-Aug 3 that were checked. Stays N/A.

ambargo.name: Drone attack on the Wildberries logistics complex in Krasnodar
ambargo.note: Drones attack the Wildberries logistics complex. Large-scale fire on the territory of the enterprise. Attribution (Nov 2026 review): USF - the USF commander (Madyar) lists Krasnodar among the Wildberries hubs hit in his Telegram posts of July 25 (t.me/robert_magyar/2654) and July 30 (t.me/robert_magyar/2676). No formal claim naming a specific unit. Confidence: medium. Detail (Nov 2026): Exilenova+ and Astra (July 22, videos and photos attached) say a Wildberries logistics centre in Krasnodar was attacked, with a large fire in several seats and 20-30 explosions heard, Wildberries announced an evacuation, and Exilenova+ gives the point as 45.0502N 39.0286E; Kiber Boroshno's BDA of July 30 (in sources) puts the hub at 45.0517N 39.0647E, about 145,000 sq m, and counts it among the destroyed ones.

ambargo.name: Drone attack on the Wildberries warehouse in Nevinnomyssk

Attribution (Nov 2026 review): USF + SBU + GUR - the USF commander's post of Aug 2 (t.me/robert_magyar/2690) credits the strike on the Lukoil-Volgogradneftepererabotka refinery to the 1st Separate Center and the 414th Brigade of the USF jointly with the SBU and GUR, and the SBU statement of July 31 (card attached) says the SBU hit it together with the Defense Forces. This replaces the earlier GUR primary, for which no first-party claim was found. Detail (Nov 2026): Exilenova+ (July 31, video and photo attached) says the refinery's industrial zone was burning and, at 03:46, that a massive attack was under way with the refinery and the Wildberries hub among the confirmed targets; the General Staff statement of July 31 (card attached) says Defense Forces units hit the refinery, a hit with a fire on site, about 15 million tonnes a year, with the scale of damage being established.

ambargo.name: Large-scale fire at Nizhnekamskneftekhim
ambargo.note: Large-scale fire at PJSC "Nizhnekamskneftekhim". Attribution (Nov 2026 N/A review, fifth pass): none found. Exilenova+ (July 31, videos and photos attached) says a powerful fire broke out in the industrial zone of Nizhnekamskneftekhim after an explosion and that it was probably an accident from system overload after the series of drone attacks on the zone, the fire covering a large part of the plant, and its second post shows the moment of a powerful explosion; no source names a unit; no unit or official claim was found in the General Staff, SBU, SOF and USF posts of July 1-Aug 3 that were checked. Stays N/A.

ambargo.name: Drone attack on Wildberries logistics complex in Volgograd
ambargo.note: Drones attack the Wildberries logistics complex. Large-scale fire on the premises of the enterprise. Attribution (Nov 2026 review): USF - the USF commander (Madyar) called the Volgograd hub his ninth Wildberries hit in his Telegram post of July 31 (t.me/robert_magyar/2681). No formal claim naming a specific unit. Confidence: medium. Detail (Nov 2026): Exilenova+ (July 31, videos and photo attached) shows the moment of the drone attack on the Wildberries warehouses at night and the smoke over the city, and Astra's OSINT analysis (July 31, videos attached) confirms the warehouse burning and quotes the governor on five injured; Exilenova+ also says the Wildberries distribution centre in Volgograd, a logistics complex of 44,000 sq m that serves the Volgograd, Astrakhan and neighbouring regions, was among the first objects hit in the night attack.

ambargo.name: Fire at DNS equipment warehouse in Vladivostok

Exilenova+ (July 31, video attached) posted the fire at the "DNS" equipment warehouse in Vladivostok, 5,000 sq m, as a "bonus" and Fontanka (in sources) carries the report; no source names a cause or a Ukrainian unit, and the city is thousands of kilometres from Ukraine; no unit or official claim was found in the General Staff, SBU, SOF and USF posts of July 1-Aug 3 that were checked. Stays N/A.

ambargo.name: Drones attack underground Shahed fuel and warhead warehouses in Navlya
ambargo.note: Drones attack underground warehouses with fuel and warheads for Shahed UAVs. At least one warehouse was hit. Attribution (Oct 2026 GS review): GS - announced by the General Staff as an operation of Defense Forces units; the executing unit was not named. Detail (Nov 2026): Kiber Boroshno (Aug 4, photo attached) and Dnipro Osint (Aug 4, photo attached) say drones hit the site for storing, preparing and launching strike UAVs in the village of Navlya, Bryansk Oblast, and that the FIRMS fire map recorded fires on the site; the General Staff statements of Aug 2 and Aug 3 (card attached) both list the site in the Navlya area, so the first official mention comes a day after the date in the tab.

ambargo.name: Explosion at Balzi Rossi restaurant in Moscow, Maj Gen Plokhotnyuk and Chayko's son-in-law reportedly killed
ambargo.note: Explosion in the "Balzi Rossi" restaurant. Major General Valery Plokhotnyuk and Daniil Peredriy, son-in-law of Aerospace Forces commander Alexander Chayko, are reported killed. Attribution (Oct 2026 N/A review): GUR - attributed by the site rule that targeted killings, bombings and sabotage inside the Russian Federation belong to GUR; no claim of responsibility was found. Confidence: low. Detail (Nov 2026): Meduza (Aug 7) places the blast in the evening of Aug 1 in the Balzi Rossi restaurant on Kudrinskaya Square, where a birthday party of Aerospace Forces commander Alexander Chayko was reportedly under way; the National Anti-Terrorism Committee named three dead (the woman who brought the bomb, a security guard and a patron), the Russian embassy in Italy five. Mediazona and Agentstvo confirmed through state registries the deaths of Major General Valery Plokhotnyuk and Daniil Peredriy, Chayko's son-in-law, and Verstka (Aug 6) said the first report of Lieutenant General Igor Yerusalimov's death may have been a hoax, which is why the record's name is corrected. Neither GUR, the SBU nor anyone else claimed the blast and Kyiv has not commented, so the GUR attribution rests only on the site rule.
ambargo.weapon: Bomb carried into the restaurant (reportedly by a woman; details not confirmed)

ambargo.name: Drone attack on Bashneft-UNPZ refinery in Ufa

No footage of this night's strikes was found in the channels checked; the videos of Aug 2 belong to the next attack.

ambargo.name: Fire at Bashneft-UNPZ refinery in Ufa after drone attack
ambargo.note: Drones attack the "Bashneft-UNPZ" refinery*. Fire on the premises of the enterprise. * The exact location of the impact has not been identified. ambargo.name: Drone attack on Saratov refinery, AVT-6 unit hit
ambargo.note: Drones attack a refinery. The AVT-6 unit was hit. ambargo.name: Drone attack on Wildberries logistics complex in Novosemeykino
ambargo.note: Drones attack the Wildberries logistics complex. Large-scale fire on the premises of the enterprise. Detail (Nov 2026): Exilenova+ (Aug 2, videos attached) says the Wildberries distribution center in Novosemeykino, a complex of 178,600 sq m, was hit and posted the burning warehouse; Astra (Aug 2, videos and photos attached) says its OSINT analysis found the Novosemeykino complex under attack on the morning of Aug 2; Madyar's post of Aug 2 (in sources) counts the Samara hub as the tenth hit of the Wildberries campaign.

ambargo.name: Drone attack on BGTU building in Belgorod, large-scale fire

ambargo.name: Drone attack on Wildberries logistics complex in Sobinsky, Vladimir Oblast
ambargo.note: Drones attack the Wildberries logistics complex. Large-scale fire on the premises of the enterprise. Detail (Nov 2026): Exilenova+ (Aug 3, videos attached) says the Wildberries logistics center of 171,900 sq m was under attack and posted the moment a FP-1 strike drone arrived at the warehouse in Vladimir Oblast; Kiber Boroshno (Aug 4, photo attached) says FP-1 drones destroyed the "Vladimir - Vorshinskoye" distribution center (56.0539N 40.1237E) on the morning of Aug 3; Astra (Aug 3, videos attached) quotes the company that the warehouse stopped work and the governor that one person was hurt.

ambargo.name: LSR partisans set 2 transformers on fire in Novocherkassk
ambargo.note: LSR partisans set fire to 2 transformers. Detail (Nov 2026): the LSR channel (Aug 3, claim post attached) says its fighters burned two 110 kV power transformers, half a million dollars each, at the substation of the Novocherkassk Electric Locomotive Plant (NEVZ), a plant that builds more than half of Russia's electric locomotives and repairs and modernizes them (claim post attached). Not independently verified.

ambargo.name: Drone attack on Syzran refinery, LCh-35/11-600 reforming unit hit

Stays N/A.

One earlier source (Kiber Boroshno 13388) described the Vladimir hub and is moved to that record.

ambargo.name: Drone attack on Bashneft-Novoil refinery, ZhEKSA and L-35-11/1000 hit

ambargo.name: Drone attack on Ilsky refinery, AVT-6 column hit
ambargo.note: Drones attack a refinery. The AVT-6 column was hit. ambargo.name: Drones destroy S-400 Triumf air defense system in Gelendzhik
ambargo.note: Drones destroy an S-400 "Triumf" air defense system. ambargo.name: Drones hit 2 Msta-S self-propelled howitzers in Shebekino

ambargo.name: Drone attack on TANECO refinery in Nizhnekamsk

ambargo.name: Drones hit TOS-1A Solntsepyok in Titovka

ambargo.name: Fire at RN-Komsomolskiy refinery in Komsomolsk-on-Amur
ambargo.note: LLC "RN-Komsomolskiy NPZ" is on fire. Attribution (Nov 2026 N/A review, fifth pass): none found. Exilenova+ (Aug 11, videos and photos attached) says the refinery in Komsomolsk-on-Amur, Khabarovsk Krai, caught fire "quite by accident", and Astra (Aug 11, video and photos attached) says its OSINT analysis shows the Komsomolsk refinery burning; the refinery is about 7,000 km from Ukraine, and no unit or official claim was found in the General Staff, SBU, SOF and Madyar (USF) posts of Aug 1-Sep 2 that were checked. Stays N/A.

ambargo.name: Drone attack on Wildberries logistics complex in Aleksandrovka, Voronezh Oblast
ambargo.note: Drones attack the Wildberries logistics complex. Large-scale fire on the premises of the enterprise. Detail (Nov 2026): Exilenova+ (Aug 11, videos attached) posted the burning Wildberries hub and the black smoke over Voronezh, and Astra (Aug 11, videos attached) says its OSINT analysis shows the logistics complex in a suburb of Voronezh was attacked and burning. Madyar's post of Aug 11 (in sources) says the USF "Free Ukrainian Bird" delivered the "last parcel" to the new Wildberries hub in Voronezh, and the USF report carried by Armyinform (Aug 11, in sources) says the hub of 156,000 sq. m burned down completely.

ambargo.name: Drone attack on frigate Admiral Makarov in Novorossiysk
ambargo.note: Drones attack the Project 11356 frigate "Admiral Makarov". Attribution (Nov 2026 review): SBU + GUR + GS + USF + SOF - the SBU statement of Aug 12 (card attached) says the SBU, together with the General Staff, GUR, the State Border Guard Service, the Navy and other Defense Forces components, ran the operation with drones, Palianytsia jet drones, Neptune missiles and strike systems from naval platforms; the SOF statement of Aug 12 (card attached) says SOF Deep Strike units took part together with the other components and that SOF drones reached their targets (air defense, port infrastructure and Black Sea Fleet ships); Madyar's post of Aug 12 (in sources) says the USF "Free Ukrainian Bird" also visited the naval base, the ships and the port infrastructure. The SBU statement names this frigate among the confirmed hits on two Kalibr carriers. The existing SBU primary is kept and the other units are added. Detail (Nov 2026): Exilenova+ (Aug 12, videos attached) posted a video with the moment of an impact during the attack on Novorossiysk and a video of a jet-type drone flying in and hitting after a missile alert; its analysis of the same day (photos attached) and a follow-up post (photo attached) say the Project 11356R frigate "Admiral Makarov" was damaged around the Kalibr launchers (eight cells) and the rear superstructure with radars, and in_factum (Aug 13, satellite images attached) repeats this from new Vantor images. The General Staff statement of Aug 12 (card attached) lists the frigates "Admiral Makarov" and "Admiral Essen", the "Buyan-M" and the "Vasily Bykov" as damaged.

ambargo.name: Drone attack on frigate Admiral Essen in Novorossiysk
ambargo.note: Drones attack the Project 11356 frigate "Admiral Essen". Attribution (Nov 2026 review): SBU + GUR + GS + USF + SOF - the SBU statement of Aug 12 (card attached) says the SBU, together with the General Staff, GUR, the State Border Guard Service, the Navy and other Defense Forces components, ran the operation with drones, Palianytsia jet drones, Neptune missiles and strike systems from naval platforms; the SOF statement of Aug 12 (card attached) says SOF Deep Strike units took part together with the other components and that SOF drones reached their targets (air defense, port infrastructure and Black Sea Fleet ships); Madyar's post of Aug 12 (in sources) says the USF "Free Ukrainian Bird" also visited the naval base, the ships and the port infrastructure. The SBU statement names this frigate among the confirmed hits on two Kalibr carriers. The existing SBU primary is kept and the other units are added. Detail (Nov 2026): Exilenova+ (Aug 12, photos attached) says the Project 11356R frigate "Admiral Essen" was damaged around its Kalibr launchers (eight cells), and in_factum (Aug 13, satellite images attached) repeats this from new Vantor images. The General Staff statement of Aug 12 (card attached) lists the frigates "Admiral Makarov" and "Admiral Essen", the "Buyan-M" and the "Vasily Bykov" as damaged. No video of the hit on this ship was found.

ambargo.name: Drone attack on Buyan-M small missile ship in Novorossiysk
ambargo.note: Drones attack the Project 21631 small missile ship "Buyan-M". * The exact location of the impact has not been identified. Attribution (Oct 2026 GS review): GS - announced by the General Staff as an operation of Defense Forces units; the executing unit was not named. Detail (Nov 2026): the General Staff statement of Aug 12 (card attached) names the Project 21631 "Buyan-M" small missile ship among four ships that took damage of varying degree, based on preliminary information. The SBU statement (in sources) lists three other ships and the satellite analyses found for this raid do not show this ship, so no photo or video of the damage was found and the exact impact point stays unidentified.

ambargo.name: Drone attack on patrol ship Vasily Bykov in Novorossiysk
ambargo.note: Drones attack the Project 22160 patrol ship "Vasily Bykov". Attribution (Nov 2026 review): SBU + GUR + GS + USF + SOF - the SBU statement of Aug 12 (card attached) says the SBU, together with the General Staff, GUR, the State Border Guard Service, the Navy and other Defense Forces components, ran the operation with drones, Palianytsia jet drones, Neptune missiles and strike systems from naval platforms; the SOF statement of Aug 12 (card attached) says SOF Deep Strike units took part together with the other components and that SOF drones reached their targets (air defense, port infrastructure and Black Sea Fleet ships); Madyar's post of Aug 12 (in sources) says the USF "Free Ukrainian Bird" also visited the naval base, the ships and the port infrastructure. The SBU statement confirms this patrol ship as hit. The existing SBU primary is kept and the other units are added. Detail (Nov 2026): the General Staff statement of Aug 12 (card attached) and the SBU statement (card attached) both list the Project 22160 patrol ship "Vasily Bykov" as hit; in_factum (Aug 13, satellite images attached) says new Vantor images show no apparent direct hit but an impact mark on the pier next to the ship.

ambargo.name: Drone attack on minesweeper Akvamarin-M in Novorossiysk
ambargo.note: Drones attack the Project 266M minesweeper "Akvamarin-M". Attribution (Nov 2026 review): SBU + GUR + GS + USF + SOF - the SBU statement of Aug 12 (card attached) says the SBU, together with the General Staff, GUR, the State Border Guard Service, the Navy and other Defense Forces components, ran the operation with drones, Palianytsia jet drones, Neptune missiles and strike systems from naval platforms; the SOF statement of Aug 12 (card attached) says SOF Deep Strike units took part together with the other components and that SOF drones reached their targets (air defense, port infrastructure and Black Sea Fleet ships); Madyar's post of Aug 12 (in sources) says the USF "Free Ukrainian Bird" also visited the naval base, the ships and the port infrastructure. This ship is not named in the official statements; it belongs to the same night's raid on the naval base. The existing SBU primary is kept and the other units are added. Detail (Nov 2026): in_factum (Aug 13, satellite images attached) says new Vantor images show the Project 266M minesweeper "Akvamarin-M" took a fair share: two impacts on the pier right next to it; the Exilenova+ analysis of Aug 12 (photos attached) lists a Project 266M minesweeper among the probably hit ships.

ambargo.name: Drone attack on research vessel Viktor Cherokov in Novorossiysk
ambargo.note: Drones attack the Project 20360 OS research vessel "Viktor Cherokov". * The exact location of the impact has not been identified. Attribution (Nov 2026 review): SBU + GUR + GS + USF + SOF - the SBU statement of Aug 12 (card attached) says the SBU, together with the General Staff, GUR, the State Border Guard Service, the Navy and other Defense Forces components, ran the operation with drones, Palianytsia jet drones, Neptune missiles and strike systems from naval platforms; the SOF statement of Aug 12 (card attached) says SOF Deep Strike units took part together with the other components and that SOF drones reached their targets (air defense, port infrastructure and Black Sea Fleet ships); Madyar's post of Aug 12 (in sources) says the USF "Free Ukrainian Bird" also visited the naval base, the ships and the port infrastructure. ambargo.name: Drone attack on reconnaissance ship Priazovye in Novorossiysk
ambargo.note: Drones attack the Project 864 reconnaissance ship "Priazovye". Attribution (Nov 2026 review): SBU + GUR + GS + USF + SOF - the SBU statement of Aug 12 (card attached) says the SBU, together with the General Staff, GUR, the State Border Guard Service, the Navy and other Defense Forces components, ran the operation with drones, Palianytsia jet drones, Neptune missiles and strike systems from naval platforms; the SOF statement of Aug 12 (card attached) says SOF Deep Strike units took part together with the other components and that SOF drones reached their targets (air defense, port infrastructure and Black Sea Fleet ships); Madyar's post of Aug 12 (in sources) says the USF "Free Ukrainian Bird" also visited the naval base, the ships and the port infrastructure.
